fields.title: Product Manager, E-Invoicing
fields.description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy.

About the role

Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have.

We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience.

This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market.

What you'll do

  • Own the e-invoicing product vision and roadmap, translating complex and evolving regulatory requirements into a coherent multi-year strategy
  • Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines
  • Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality
  • Define and own the end-to-end user journey: from onboarding (including business identity verification) to live invoice transmission via certified networks like Peppol
  • Work closely with the Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Connect teams to embed e-invoicing as a native part of Stripe's financial infrastructure — not a bolted-on feature
  • Establish quality, reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement
  • Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to position Stripe as the leading e-invoicing solution for upmarket and enterprise customers
  • Represent Stripe credibly with regulators, certification bodies, and industry partners as we build direct relationships with key tax authorities and networks

Who you are

Required

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain
  • Deep familiarity with the e-invoicing landscape — you understand CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America
  • Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture
  • Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into concrete roadmap decisions
  • Experience launching products across multiple markets simultaneously, including navigating localization, regulatory compliance, and differing user needs
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — you get things done across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM without formal authority
  • Clear, direct communication: you can distill a complex compliance landscape into a compelling product narrative for both internal stakeholders and external audiences

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating third-party technology providers or acquisitions into a core product platform
  • Familiarity with Stripe Billing, Invoicing, or Tax products
  • Prior experience building toward Peppol access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF)
  • Exposure to B2B invoicing workflows in mid-market or enterprise contexts

Why this role, why now

E-invoicing is one of the most consequential shifts in global business compliance in a decade, and Stripe is early in building the infrastructure to make it effortless. You'll have the mandate, the resources, and the cross-functional backing to build something significant — and the chance to make Stripe synonymous with world-class e-invoicing.

Stripe is an equal opportunity employer. We look for people with exceptional abilities, who are excited by hard problems and big opportunities.

fields.description:

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About the team

This role is open to remote candidates located anywhere within the Eastern Time Zone.  Global Payouts empowers Stripe users to move money effortlessly, quickly, and securely to anyone, anywhere. Businesses rely on us to distribute billions of dollars to employees, contractors, sellers, and claimants across our Dashboard, APIs, and platform integrations via Financial Accounts.We are gaining rapid momentum across both self-serve and enterprise segments. Our demand spans high-growth fintechs, leading AI platforms, and some of the world's largest marketplaces.

We are now entering a decisive phase of expansion. Over the next 12–18 months, the capabilities we build robust cross-border infrastructure, advanced enterprise controls, and tailored vertical-specific features will determine whether Global Payouts becomes the definitive default for businesses distributing money at scale. This role sits at the absolute center of that mission.

What you'll do

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to spearhead our cross-border expansion and enterprise capabilities. This is a high-impact, broad-scope role where you will set the strategic vision and drive execution across two pillars essential to our hyper-growth:

  • Cross-border: You will expand the reach and competitive edge of our cross-border infrastructure by building out rate locking, local bank account coverage, and cross-border card rails. Crucially, you will lead the productization of fee passthrough—translating a bespoke solution originally built for a major AI platform into a broadly available, highly scalable capability.
  • Enterprise: You will define and deliver the advanced controls, reporting, and billing features required by sophisticated, high-volume operators. This includes recipient tax reporting, two-step confirmation workflows, enterprise billing models (e.g., IC+, platform fees), and robust security access controls.

Across both domains, you will partner directly with Sales, Partnerships, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to convert active enterprise demand into durable product investments, developing industry-specific capabilities for key verticals like remittance and fintech.

Responsibilities

Cross-Border Expansion

  • Own the roadmap for global payout infrastructure, prioritizing rate locking, local bank coverage, and cross-border card rails.
  • Productize fee passthrough, transforming a custom integration into a scalable, self-serve offering to drive rapid adoption among new users.
  • Design industry-specific solutions for high-value verticals (e.g., remittance, fintech) rooted in deep user research and strategic GTM alignment.

Enterprise Capabilities

  • Ship enterprise-grade controls and reporting tools, including recipient tax reporting, two-step confirmation workflows, and advanced security access controls.
  • Architect enterprise billing primitives—such as Interchange Plus (IC+) and platform fees—to enable flexible, scalable commercial models for large payout operators.

fields.title: Product Manager, Identity & Access Management
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

IAM is the nerve center of Stripe. We control how millions of businesses grant access to their account, including employees, AI agents, apps, and API integrations, across the Dashboard, API, CLI, and MCP. We're also a platform team, building the unified, fine-grained permissions model that every product at Stripe builds on.

AI agents are changing how businesses operate, and how they get authorized, governed, and secured is being defined right now—largely by us. We’re tackling challenging and unsolved problems for real businesses, like how to model agents when they blur the line between acting on behalf of a human vs. standalone principals, or how to authorize entire agent workflows rather than step-by-step actions. We’re collaborating directly with the frontier AI labs on the evolution of MCP, new identity protocols, and agent integrations. We build for solo founders and Fortune 500s alike, and the tension between those two is where the real product work lives.

What you’ll do

You'll set the vision and drive the roadmap for how every principal, human, agent, or app, gets access to a Stripe account. You'll do it by talking directly to the founders, admins, and developers who use it.

  • Design the experience of granting access, everywhere. Signing up, inviting a teammate, creating an API key, authorizing an agent or a third-party app.
  • Design for agents specifically. Design for agents as a new principal within Stripe, including how they authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how businesses stay in control, including approvals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for actions involving real money. You're defining an experience that will set the industry standard. 
  • Drive least privilege, made easy. Take holistic ownership across Stripe to ensure that every user, app and agent has only the permissions it requires. Build custom roles, smart permission defaults, and permission recommendations based on real API usage to make least-privilege authorization easy rather than tedious. 
  • Push toward a world without secrets. Make secretless authentication (Workload Identity Federation) the default way developers integrate with Stripe to prevent emerging security threats from increasingly sophisticated and AI-powered attackers. 
  • Partner across all of Stripe. Pitch an ambitious vision, then get teams across Dashboard, API Platform, Security, Payments and Money Movement genuinely excited to build it with you.

Who you are

The hardest part of this job, and the most fun, is the constant trade-off: usability vs. security, flexibility vs. simplicity. It takes taste to find a shape that feels effortless for a solo founder and holds up at Fortune 500 scale.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years in PM, shipping platform or infrastructure products that other teams build on
  • Background in security, identity, auth, or developer platforms, or serious curiosity about the space
  • A habit of talking to users to find the real problem, not the reported one
  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on authorization and authentication design
  • A bias toward experimentation over big-bang launches
  • Comfort setting direction in a space that's still being invented, across teams you don't manage

Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the team

Join our Issuance Product team to shape the future of financial access and infrastructure. We're not just improving global payments, we're reinventing them with modern rails that allow for fast, cheap transactions at any size. You will build a platform that powers issuing compliant stablecoins in US/EU and beyond. We work with some of the largest fintechs, crypto companies, blockchains and more. This is your chance to lead meaningful innovation from day one, redefining the way businesses and people exchange value globally.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Build a world class issuance platform that has the scale to power billions of dollars of transactions and issued stablecoins. Product areas include liquidity delivery, reserves management, mint/burn infrastructure, rewards, on-chain/crypto smart contracts, and launching custom stablecoins.  
  • Drive product features from ideation to launch, collaborating with designers, engineers, and cross-functional partners such as legal and compliance.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our users’ needs, operational landscape, and competitive environment across international markets.
  • Own outcomes end-to-end, using data, feedback, and rapid iteration to refine your approach.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • Empathy for users: You’re passionate about uncovering and solving pain points.
  • Deep curiosity: You never stop asking “why” and dig into both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Owner’s mentality: You tackle challenges head-on and drive solutions with conviction.
  • Collaborative spirit: You work seamlessly with team members but aren’t afraid to make the call when needed.
  • Clarity and simplicity: You translate complex systems into intuitive, straightforward user experiences.
  • Bias for learning: You embrace mistakes as opportunities to grow and improve quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years in product management or a related role, with a proven record of delivering impactful products.

  • Strong business acumen and comfort navigating ecosystem and platform-level challenges.
  • Experience integrating APIs, managing developer platforms, or building ecosystem-driven products.
  • Experience building regulated infrastructure in fintech, payments, or crypto.

If you’re ready to shape the future of how money moves, we want to hear from you!

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.

Stripe Apps connect Stripe with the tools businesses already use, bringing relevant data and workflows into the Stripe Dashboard and third-party systems. The Strategic Apps team owns a portfolio of integrations with enterprise systems that are critical to our users’ workflows—from quote-to-cash and support to reporting. We help users embed Stripe more deeply into the way they run their businesses.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to set the strategy and lead execution for Strategic Apps. You will own a portfolio of existing and new integrations, including those with systems such as Salesforce, and determine where Stripe should invest based on user needs, Stripe’s product and industry priorities, and market signals. You will work across Stripe and directly with external partners to deliver reliable, high-quality integrations that drive adoption and business outcomes.

  • Own the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a portfolio of strategic apps, making and communicating clear trade-offs amid significant ambiguity.
  • Identify, prioritize, and validate the highest-value user problems and integration opportunities through direct user research, ecosystem analysis, and quantitative evidence.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Sales, User Support, Marketing, Partner Management, and other product teams to deliver and evolve integrations end to end.
  • Partner with Engineering to define product requirements, technical approach, and quality standards for integrations, including APIs, documentation, edge cases, reliability, security, compliance, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Establish feedback loops and measurement plans before launch; use product, business, and user metrics to assess efficacy, diagnose changes in performance, and continuously improve adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes.
  • Represent Stripe’s product strategy with strategic technology partners and enterprise users, building productive relationships with product and technical counterparts and incorporating their feedback into roadmap decisions.
  • Drive launches, beta programs, user acceptance testing, and go-to-market readiness in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, and Support; ensure teams have the materials and operating model needed to support adoption at scale.
  • Make and drive important cross-functional decisions, align senior stakeholders around a shared strategy, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly.
  • Balance new feature development with investment in quality, reliability, technical debt, and foundational platform capabilities across the app portfolio.
  • Improve how Stripe builds and operates strategic integrations by turning user, partner, and performance signals into scalable product and process improvements.

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of relevant product-management, engineering, or equivalent experience, including ownership of a high-quality product or feature area at scale or a major evolution of an existing product.
  • Experience setting product strategy and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams or a complex product area, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and iteration.
  • Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to define success metrics, evaluate product performance, and make prioritization decisions.
  • Strong technical judgment and fluency working with engineers on API-based products, integrations, technical constraints, and product quality.
  • Experience engaging directly with enterprise users and external technology partners, and translating their needs into clear product decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading through organizational boundaries.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise business systems and workflows, such as CRM, ERP, quote-to-cash, support, or reporting platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics is a plus.
  • Experience building or scaling platform, ecosystem, marketplace, or partner-integrated products.
  • Experience growing product adoption, usage, or revenue through product-led and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Experience in payments, financial technology, or other regulated technology environments.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

fields.title: Product Manager, Support Platform
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Support Technologies builds the products, platforms, and capabilities behind Stripe’s support experiences. The team helps users resolve issues quickly, supports internal teams, and creates reusable technology that improves support across Stripe.

This role focuses on the complex support needs of Platforms and Connect. Platforms, connected accounts, and their customers each have different relationships with Stripe, access levels, and responsibilities. Resolving an issue often requires understanding who owns the account, which permissions apply, how products are configured, and which party should provide support.

The team is building the foundations for more contextual support across this multi-party ecosystem. A key part of the work is improving Stripe’s customer-facing AI agent so it can understand these relationships, handle complex cases, and provide accurate, personalized resolutions at scale.

What you’ll do

As a Product Manager for Support Experience, you will be responsible for improving the outcomes of Stripe’s user-facing AI agent that holds 100k+ conversations per week. You’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, solving problems for businesses and consumers, and redefining what great can look like. You’ll directly build agent capabilities to solve real-world user problems. That means getting hands-on with prompts, evals, skills, tools and the machinery that lets you introspect and identify opportunities within the conversational experience.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the product strategy and roadmap for Support Technologies serving Platform and Connect use cases.
  • Build a deep understanding of the needs of platform operators, connected accounts, Stripe support teams, and platform support teams.
  • Improve the capabilities and effectiveness of Stripe’s user-facing AI agent for Platform and Connect support experiences.
  • Identify recurring support problems and translate them into reusable product, platform, and AI agent capabilities.
  • Build, ship, and iterate on the prompts, skills, tools, and evaluations that enable the AI agent to solve real-world user problems.
  • Improve how account relationships, roles, permissions, product configurations, and support history inform routing and resolution across AI and human-assisted support.
  • Build tools that help the AI agent and support teams understand complex Platform and Connect issues and take the right next action.
  • Enable platforms to support their connected accounts more effectively through appropriate tooling, visibility, automation, and contextual guidance.
  • Help clarify whether Stripe, the platform, or another party is responsible for resolving a user’s issue, and route the issue accordingly.
  • Create continuous improvement loops that turn insights from AI agent conversations and support interactions into scaled solutions.
  • Partner with Platform, Connect, and conversational AI product teams to incorporate support capabilities into critical product journeys.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. 

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of product management experience, excluding internships and co-ops.
  • Deep user empathy and a high bar for user experience.
  • Experience leading cross-team initiatives from ideation through execution.
  • Experience leading technical products or a background in computer science or a similar field.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

About the team

Treasury for Platforms sits at the center of Stripe's evolution from a payments processor to a complete financial infrastructure provider. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and Treasury extends that mission by enabling marketplaces, software-as-a-service platforms, and fintechs to embed fully featured financial services directly into their own products.

By handling bank partnerships, compliance, and regulatory requirements, we allow platforms to launch quickly while focusing on the core parts of their business. We pair this with embedded user interfaces, managed support, and rich treasury features so our users can build great financial experiences.

Today, our platforms serve a highly diverse set of use cases, from payout cards for on-demand workers and operational accounts for in-field purchases to financial accounts for small businesses. We proudly power industry-leading products like Shopify Balance and Ambrook Wallet, serving a rapidly growing roster of users across the United States.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a Product Manager to own and drive critical Treasury for Platforms infrastructure and features, including new account types, checkbooks, and accounting integrations. You will take these products from alpha to general availability across consumer and commercial Treasury. You will work directly with platforms by joining sales calls, running product demos, and shaping integration paths. You will be the most technically fluent person in the room with the user and the most user-fluent person in the room with engineering. Ultimately, you’ll turn every platform into a financial hub for its users.

Responsibilities

  • Deeply understand the financial management needs of our diverse user base and how they can benefit from strong treasury features.
  • Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and roadmap that aligns with Stripe’s broader vision and market demands.
  • Drive product development from ideation to launch, ensuring the delivery of high-value experiences for our users.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, legal, and other teams to ensure cohesive execution and alignment across all phases of product development and launch.
  • Advocate for the Treasury for Platforms vision internally and externally, ensuring key stakeholders are informed and engaged.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record of launching impactful products.
  • An ownership mindset and willingness to do what it takes to solve problems and delight consumers.
  • Ability to handle and prioritize work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for distilling user problems into precise, actionable framing.
  • Rigorous approach to data, including comfort digging into metrics, writing SQL when needed, and thinking from first principles to deliver the right result.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in treasury services and financial account management.
  • Experience building platforms with multiparty transaction capabilities.
  • Experience managing high-stakes external partnerships.
  • Understanding of international payments, foreign exchange, and compliance.

About the team

Our Product Marketing team's mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe's product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch.

We are looking to hire a Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market strategy and drive adoption for Stripe's data products — including Sigma, Data Pipeline, Database, and new products we’re incubating. As monetization grows more complex — from AI companies hyperscaling globally to enterprises integrating Stripe deeply into their operations — data has become a critical lever that helps businesses make better decisions.

What you'll do

As a key owner of our GTM strategy for Stripe's data products, you'll need to quickly build a deep understanding of our products, the data analytics buyer, and our competitive differentiation. You will:

  • Be the expert on our data analytics buyers — understand how data analysts, analytics engineers, and BI practitioners evaluate and adopt tools, and translate those insights into product roadmap recommendations and GTM strategy.
  • Own positioning and messaging for Stripe's data products, building a clear and differentiated point of view in a competitive market.
  • Drive end-to-end go-to-market for data product launches — from defining the narrative and target audience to developing the assets and programs that drive adoption across sold and self-serve motions.
  • Partner with demand generation and campaigns to design and execute programs that reach the data analytics buyer and accelerate product adoption at scale.
  • Build sales enablement — develop the messaging frameworks, competitive battlecards, and assets that help sales teams clearly articulate the value of Stripe's data products.
  • Own competitive intelligence for the analytics and BI landscape, tracking competitors and turning that intelligence into differentiated positioning and sales tools.
  • Define program KPIs and maintain accountability to measurable business outcomes across the data products portfolio.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in B2B tech.
  • A builder mentality with a strong bias to action. Comfortable with ambiguity, able to experiment and adapt at pace.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with a proven track record of distilling complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for executive and external audiences.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and ability to influence across all levels and functions, from senior leadership to project teams.
  • High comfort toggling between strategy and execution — big picture to fine detail.
  • Proven ability to translate customer and market insights into differentiated positioning and measurable GTM programs.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep familiarity with the data analytics ecosystem — BI tools, cloud data warehouses, and analytics workflows — and a proven ability to market to the data analyst or analytics engineer buyer.
  • Experience marketing to technical audiences such as data engineers, analytics engineers, or developers.
  • Power user (and builder) of AI-powered tooling.

fields.title: Product Marketing Manager, Bridge/Stablecoins
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe and Bridge

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Bridge, acquired by Stripe in 2025, is an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement.

About the team

We're looking for a driven, strategic, and results-oriented PMM to join the product marketing team at Bridge, focused on our Open Issuance, Orchestration and FX product lines.

As an early PMM for Bridge, you’ll be responsible for product marketing across the lifecycle, from helping shape the product with market insights, to crafting messaging, to growing product awareness and adoption in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Product, and more. This is a highly-cross functional role that will work both across the teams at Bridge and at Stripe to help grow the Bridge business.

You’ll be embedded with the Bridge team while also being part of the Stripe product marketing team.

What you’ll do

  • Be a storyteller. You have deep empathy for our core audience and are able to adapt how you communicate to best reach and engage your audience. You can translate complex infrastructure concepts—stablecoin issuance, cross-border FX, payment orchestration—into clear, compelling narratives that differentiate Bridge.
  • Lead with data. You like working with data and insights and pair that with your passion for users to generate balanced and thoughtful points of view for how to take products to market
  • Keep things organized. You are able to manage highly interdependent, complex projects and keep various work streams on track. You're comfortable running multiple launches in parallel across different product lines and coordinating across Bridge, Privy, and Stripe teams.
  • Have a passion for fintech and crypto. You are keen to learn about how things work and are able to explain technical concepts in ways that everyday people can understand. You’re deeply curious about fintech and crypto and translate that passion into impactful product marketing.
  • Be ambitious and thrive in complexity. You are eager to make an impact at Bridge (and consequently, Stripe). You thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic, hyper-growth environment and are able to operate fluidly between the 30,000-foot strategy level and the micro-detail to get things right
  • Act as a team player. Product Marketers collaborate with basically every team in the business. You are able to work with a range of disciplines to execute on your work

Responsibilities 

  • Own the end-to-end product marketing strategy for Open Issuance, Orchestration and FX, including messaging, positioning, ICP definition, sales enablement, and demand generation campaigns
  • Drive go-to-market for product expansions (new currencies, corridors, pricing improvements), ensuring GTM teams have the right positioning, playbooks, and enablement content from day one
  • Build and maintain competitive positioning in a crowded market, clearly articulating Bridge's differentiation to the right developer and customer segments
  • Lead marketing for product releases and launches across your product areas, coordinating with product, comms, content, and demand gen
  • Create and maintain sales and marketing assets (case studies, solution pages, pitch decks, one-pagers, enablement and trainings) that drive pipeline conversion
  • Act as a liaison between Bridge and Stripe product marketing to bring connectivity across the marketing strategy for both parts of the business
  • Flex into other Bridge marketing needs as they arise, supporting the broader team during peak moments

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience including B2B product marketing, marketing, product management, and management consulting
  • Ability to be agile and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Experience in working in businesses that offer API-based products, fintech and crypto experience is a plus
  • Action-oriented and comfortable moving forward without clear guidelines or instructions
  • Excellent writing and communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics for diverse audiences
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making
  • Strong cross-functional relationship builder at all levels of an organization

Positioned at the nexus of product development, engineering, and partnerships, we facilitate seamless collaboration essential for supporting Stripe’s rapid growth.


Our team is a diverse mix of technical and business professionals dedicated to executing operations with financial ecosystem partners. We ensure efficient technical onboarding and implementation, while also overseeing ongoing KTLO (Keep-The-Lights-On) activities and achieving strict quality and performance benchmarks. Additionally, the PE&O team initiates partner-agnostic programs and solutions to tackle broad ecosystem challenges, developing tools that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

In This Role

The team is establishing a new function to oversee Card Network Compliance. In this position, you will be responsible for developing programs and processes to address Stripe’s card network changes and their implications for both Stripe and its users. This role is crucial for ensuring we stay informed about ongoing card network announcements, enhancing our strategic position, and driving operational efficiency in response to changes.

 

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to building a function from the ground up and to help formulate strategies that align with the best interests of Stripe and its users!

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Implement Release Management Process: Establish a release management process for Stripe in accordance with Card Network mandates, advising all cross-functional partners on the impacts, changes, and timelines associated with network updates. Conduct comprehensive analyses of how these mandates affect existing processes and services.
  • Review Card Network Releases: Review, analyze, and assess biannual card network releases to identify key initiatives that will significantly impact Stripe’s business. Collaborate cross-functionally with various teams to ensure proper visibility and prioritization of these initiatives. Facilitate communication between engineering teams and the card networks' Technical Partner Managers (TPaMs) to streamline clarifications and negotiations regarding complex mandates and programs.
  • Monitor Compliance: Establish a framework and process for monitoring compliance with card network requirements and internal policies. Ensure regular audits and assessments are conducted to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement strategies.
  • Develop Metrics and Dashboards: Create and implement comprehensive metrics and JIRA dashboards to effectively monitor, review, and analyze mandates for each release cycle. Regularly update and refine the dashboards to reflect current business priorities and challenges, enabling teams to make informed decisions and proactively address potential issues related to card network mandates.
  • Manage Mandate Intake Process: Oversee the network mandate intake process, ensuring timely review, assessment, and prioritization of mandates. Lead the proactive management of waiver requests, liaising between compliance and operational teams for resolution.
  • Engage with External Partners: Actively engage with external network partners by participating in councils, forums, and regular strategic meetings. Establish and nurture relationships that facilitate mutual understanding of goals and objectives.
  • Advocate for Stripe: Serve as a dedicated advocate for Stripe within the card network ecosystem, ensuring that the unique perspectives, challenges, and opportunities faced by Stripe are considered by network stakeholders.

Who you are

  • In-depth understanding of acquiring platforms and systems, and their interactions with card network products and processes.
  • Proficient in navigating and using JIRA for project management and tracking. Familiarity with card network portals for managing and monitoring compliance activities. Comfortable utilizing Google Workspace tools (such as Sheets, Docs, and Slides) for collaboration and documentation.
  • Proven track record of effectively collaborating with product and engineering teams to develop new processes and strategies in partnership with them.
  • Strong program and project management abilities, with the capacity to engage and influence stakeholders outside of direct control.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively engage with both internal and external partners and drive change.
  • Ability to thrive with minimal guidance, navigating uncertainty and ambiguity while shaping a new program and function at Stripe.
  • Strategic thinker adept at identifying cross-functional issues, providing innovative solutions, and communicating the implications of these solutions across existing processes, systems, and teams.

Preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Finance, Technology) is preferred.

About the team

Global Business Services' (GBS) Commercial Solutions team ensures operational and programmatic excellence across deal cycles, increases revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drives closure of the sold portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region. GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS's priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, and User feedback and market insights. This role sits within Global Business Practices' Commercial Solutions team, responsible for developing, launching, and maintaining commercial constructs and programs to drive revenue for Stripe.

What you'll do

The Global Business Services Commercial Solutions team is looking for a Commercial Solutions Program Manager to own the end-to-end programmatic development of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs that drive revenue for Stripe. Programs have a large scope and impact in nature, including owning the development and support of first-of-its-kind commercialization efforts, ongoing program support (pre- to post-launch), custom deal support related to the program, ownership of related enablement and communications, as well as acting as a change agent across the business.

You're responsible for the end-to-end management of commercial and GBS launch readiness programs, driving cross-organizational alignment through the delivery of related outputs. This role requires a background in program management and commercial program experience, change management, and a strong understanding of and experience in scaling global, cross-organizational mechanisms.

You'll have experience in program ownership and management, custom pricing strategies, and a background in supporting selling motions. You'll have strong communication skills and executive presence to communicate with Stripes from sellers and Deal Strategies through to senior leadership. You'll love this job if you're a natural relationship and mechanism builder.

Responsibilities

  • Independently lead large-scale, cross-functional commercial or GBS launch readiness programs that have Stripe-wide impact, often first-of-their-kind programs and initiatives
  • Manage and lead complex programs that require considerable resources and high levels of complex functional and technical integration and knowledge
  • Support the commercial program deal motion, partnering with Deal Pricing and Deal Strategy Strategists, sellers, and internal stakeholders to create custom commercial approaches
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams, sales leaders, services and support teams, product teams, and cross-functional teams to develop, launch, and scale the commercial program (continuously evolving the ways Stripe goes to market) to support commercialization efforts
  • Identify, surface, and action systemic, broad issues and gaps, proposing holistic solutions to address root causes
  • Navigate complex programmatic problems at scale across Go-To-Market and Stripe, and propose creative solutions
  • Partner with cross-functional teams such as Legal, Finance, Accounting, Service Teams, Product Teams, etc. to resolve and remove internal blockers
  • Act as a liaison between Sales, Deal Pricing and Deal Strategy Strategists, and other stakeholders for custom elements
  • Facilitate meetings, working sessions, and exercises that assist the leadership team in optimizing effectiveness among themselves and across the organization in general
  • Advocate on behalf of a position and gain cross-functional alignment on the position
  • Build credibility and trust with internal stakeholders
  • Lead projects to solve existing commercialization issues

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • BA or BS degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics
  • 7+ years of experience in program management, commercial strategy, economics, deal management, or pricing, with experience owning program strategy or business operations
  • 5+ years of direct commercial pricing model program management skills, knowledge, experience, deal management, and oversight
  • Experience driving cross-team mechanism development end-to-end (ideation, planning, execution, launch, post-launch support)
  • Experience working in ambiguous, quickly scaling environments, comfortable with high-agency
  • Experience engaging with senior executives on high-priority initiatives, as well as the ability to work across internal and external organizations

  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and project management skills
  • Establish credibility and maintain working relationships with internal stakeholders involved with commercial constructs (Legal, Finance, Accounting, etc.)
  • Experience presenting data and metrics to senior leadership to report on metrics

  • Payments industry experience

fields.title: Program Manager, Competitive Programs
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Competitive Programs team, which is part of the Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategic Programs team, is a new team dedicated to establishing and scaling Stripe’s Competitive Programs capability. Stripe operates in a dynamic and evolving competitive landscape. This role will help Stripe understand market developments and translate competitive insights into actionable guidance for teams and users.

The Competitive Programs team works alongside Market Intelligence to help Stripe identify meaningful threats and opportunities early, mobilize coordinated action across the company in priority situations, and turn market and deal signals into better Product, Marketing, and GTM decisions. We build the competitive operating system—program design, cross-functional coordination, deal-routing mechanisms, visibility, and accountability—while Product, Sales, PMM, Pricing, and other functions retain ownership for decisions and delivery in their domains.

This is a full-stack program manager role. While the initial assignment is Competitive Programs, we are looking for a versatile program manager who can apply the same skills to other high-priority GTM initiatives as the team’s mandate and Stripe’s needs evolve.

What you’ll do

You will lead complex, C-suite level high-priority programs that require Stripe to move quickly and cohesively across functions. Initially, you will:

  • Build the foundations and operating mechanisms to turn ad hoc competitive programs into a repeatable, scalable playbook
  • Run one or more named competitive programs to protect strategic business, close recurring gaps, and pursue opportunities to take share
  • Partner with Stripe’s leadership to execute on initiatives to drive a strategic shift in company culture

You will be successful in this role if you can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear program with the right objectives, owners, decisions, operating cadence, and measures of success. You will be a trusted partner to executive leaders across Sales, Product, Product Operations, Marketing, Market Intelligence, Pricing, Finance & Strategy, and GTM Operations. You will not be expected to make Product roadmap, commercial-policy, or account-strategy decisions yourself; instead, you will ensure the right functional owners are engaged, accountable, and able to make decisions at the pace required.  You will need (1) superior communication skills to work across senior stakeholders from different functions and (2) are someone who thrives when solving complex problems with limited oversight.

Responsibilities

  • Build repeatable Competitive Programs infrastructure that can scale beyond individual competitors—for example, playbooks for deal escalation, commercial guidance, incentives, user-base analysis, regional teardowns, and cross-functional feedback loops.
  • Lead named P0 and P1 competitive programs end-to-end, including defining the program charter, objectives, workplan, milestones, decision forums, and success measures.
  • Establish and run the cross-functional operating cadence for each program; this may include delivery of critical program workstreams including product and regional teardowns, seller enablement, product-gap reviews, GTM plays and executive engagement plans.
  • Coordinate competitive deal-triage and swarm mechanisms for priority opportunities, ensuring each deal has a clear commercial owner, response plan, and access to the required Product, Pricing, Legal, Risk, or executive support.
  • Partner with Market Intelligence to translate competitor, customer, and deal signals into concrete actions for Product, PMM, Sales, and GTM leadership.
  • Create clear, decision-oriented reporting for executive leadership on program health, competitive pipeline, risks, progress against commitments, and recommendations to continue, adjust, elevate, or graduate a program.
  • Own and operationalize company-wide competitive cultural initiatives to shift Stripe’s behavior to be focused on competing fiercely.
  • Build strong, trusted working relationships across functions and levels, while maintaining clear accountability boundaries between central program coordination and functional ownership.
  • Apply the same program-design and execution skills to other strategic GTM priorities over time, as business needs and the team’s mandate evolve.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

You are a strategic, hands-on program leader who is comfortable working in ambiguity and accountable for creating clarity. You can move between executive-level strategy and operational detail, bring disparate groups to a decision, and build mechanisms that outlast the initial program. You are energized by the intersection of market dynamics, competitors, strategy, product, marketing, commercials and deals, and how they all bridge together in a competitive situation.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline. Experience working in a Sales, Marketing, Product, GTM Operations, or other commercial organization.
  • A strong record of leading complex and ambiguous cross-functional programs from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and operational handoff. Experience managing global programs across regions, segments, and product lines.
  • Works well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment.
  • Experience navigating multiple senior stakeholders with differing incentives, priorities, and decision rights.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs, make recommendations, and drive decisions.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to produce well-structured written updates, facilitate senior working sessions, and communicate risks or trade-offs directly.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain an operating cadence across multiple teams, including tracking milestones, dependencies, actions, and escalations.
  • A high degree of ownership, sound judgment, adaptability, and comfort working in a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to diagnose issues, assess program health, and guide prioritization.
  • An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves mentality” paired with a collaborative working style that builds trust.
  • Someone who demonstrates leadership qualities throughout their work – taking ownership of challenges, selflessly supporting their colleagues, and setting the standard for quality in their deliverables

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading competitive programs, strategic account programs, product-launch programs, commercial transformation, or other high-stakes GTM initiatives.
  • Experience working at a B2B technology, enterprise software, fintech, payments, or platform company.
  • Familiarity with competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, sales enablement, pricing, commercial strategy, or product-feedback mechanisms.
  • Experience building a new operating model, program-management function, or repeatable playbook from the ground up.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Product Operations, PMM, Sales, Pricing, Finance & Strategy, and GTM Systems teams.
  • Comfort with SQL, BI tools, or other methods of analyzing pipeline, adoption, revenue, and operational data.

fields.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

You’ll join our Customer Advocacy and Programs team, a small, high-impact team inside Customer Success, that amplifies the voice of the customer and turns feedback into measurable change. We synthesize customer input across touchpoints to surface the highest‑value opportunities, then partner with Product, GTM, Support, and Operations to turn those opportunities into strategy, deliverables, and lasting improvements. Our mission is to ensure Stripe’s most strategic customers get maximum value from their Stripe investments.

What you’ll do

As a Program Manager on the Customer Advocacy and Programs team, you’ll lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that improve how Stripe listens to, advocates for, and serves its users. Your portfolio may span customer feedback, servicing programs, operating processes, internal capabilities, and other emerging priorities across Customer Success.

You’ll take broadly defined problems from discovery through execution: developing a clear understanding of user and business needs, defining the right approach, aligning stakeholders, building an actionable plan, and driving work through launch, adoption, and iteration. You’ll move fluidly between strategy and hands-on delivery, bringing structure to ambiguity without introducing unnecessary process.

This is a generalist role for someone who can quickly develop context in new areas, identify the most important problems to solve, and mobilize teams around practical solutions. You’ll partner with leaders and frontline teams across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Operations, Data, and other functions. The specific programs you own may evolve as Stripe’s users and organizational priorities change.

Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic programs end to end: Own a portfolio of high-priority initiatives from problem definition and strategy through planning, execution, launch, and measurement.
  • Turn ambiguity into action: Diagnose complex or loosely defined problems, identify their underlying causes, and translate them into clear objectives, scope, decisions, and workplans.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Align stakeholders around shared outcomes, clarify roles and decision rights, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain momentum across teams with different priorities.
  • Represent users and frontline teams: Gather and synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights to understand user needs, frontline friction, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
  • Establish measures of success: Define meaningful program outcomes and leading indicators, build feedback loops, and use evidence to determine what to expand, improve, or stop.
  • Communicate with clarity: Produce concise recommendations, decision documents, and leadership updates that surface the most important insights, trade-offs, risks, and actions.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, business operations, strategy and operations, consulting, or a related discipline.
  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs from an ambiguous starting point through implementation, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose problems, synthesize varied inputs, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to move between strategy and detailed execution and a willingness to personally drive the work required to deliver results.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity for audiences ranging from frontline teams to senior leaders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including experience aligning teams with different incentives, perspectives, or priorities.
  • Sound judgment and prioritization skills, particularly when operating with incomplete information or changing business needs.
  • A user-oriented approach and the ability to incorporate customer and frontline perspectives into program design and decision making.
  • High adaptability and comfort developing expertise quickly across unfamiliar or evolving problem areas.
  • High degree of comfort with AI tools.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working with go-to-market or other customer-facing organizations.
  • Experience leading organizational change and driving adoption of new programs, tools, or ways of working.
  • Experience using data and qualitative research to assess problems, prioritize opportunities, and measure program effectiveness.
  • Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver tools, automation, or workflow improvements.
  • Comfort using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, communication, or program delivery.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth technology, financial services, or payments environment.

fields.title: Program Manager, Performance and Talent Planning
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you have an opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Performance and Talent Planning team is part of Stripe’s broader Talent and Development organization. We shape how Stripes grow their careers and do their best work.

We build the programs, systems, and insights that help managers develop strong teams, help leaders plan for the future, and give Stripes clear opportunities to grow. Our work spans performance, talent planning, career development, succession, and organizational insights. Our goal is to make Stripe a place where talented people can build lasting careers and have an outsized impact.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will help translate Stripe’s performance and talent philosophy into scalable, global experiences. You will work across People Products, People Insights, Employee Relations, People Partners and other partner teams to design programs and systems that are clear for users, operationally durable, and aligned with Stripe’s future needs. You will bring a product mindset to all you do, starting with data driven problem statements, qualitative and quantitative signals, an understanding of the end-to-end user experience, an iterative design process, and an obsession with continuous improvement over time. You will be comfortable operating across time zones and navigating competing perspectives, incomplete information, and urgent priorities.

A Day in the Life

You start your day by reviewing your agenda in Slack or asking your AI agent to summarize ongoing work and priorities. Energized by a mix of workstream meetings across People Products, Manager Enablement, and M&A Transitions, you check overnight updates from teammates across time zones. Colleagues in Dublin have shared feedback that keeps the launch plan moving, while teammates in Melbourne have raised thoughtful questions about how a new performance process will integrate into the existing reporting capabilities they rely on for annual talent planning.

These questions are exactly the kind of challenge you value. They push you to build with a user-first mindset, anticipate downstream impacts, and mitigate risks before they emerge. You draw on expertise from across the organization while balancing the responsibility of integrating global perspectives, designing seamless end-to-end experiences, and coordinating work across interconnected teams. A new question sparks a new connection, and you quickly identify another stakeholder who should be brought into the next phase of the program.

As the day progresses, updates from cross-functional partners show steady progress across multiple fronts, but one critical area stalls. Rather than waiting for next week's meeting, you escalate immediately to keep momentum high and de-risk the program timeline. You end the day energized by the complexity of the work, the curiosity and collaboration of your colleagues, and the opportunity to continue to build, solve, and innovate every day.

Responsibilities

  • Drive and scale Stripe’s performance philosophy and practices. Design and improve performance experiences that help Stripes understand expectations, grow through feedback, and make meaningful contributions.
  • Evolve performance and talent tooling. Partner with People Products and cross-functional stakeholders to translate program needs into scalable systems, processes, and user journeys.
  • Strengthen career growth and talent investment. Help shape the programs, mechanisms, and insights that enable career development, talent planning, succession, and thoughtful investment in Stripe’s people as the company grows.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional workstreams. Build alignment among global stakeholders; surface risks and dependencies early; make progress in ambiguous environments; and unblock critical decisions quickly.
  • Use insights to improve outcomes. Define clear problem statements, gather qualitative and quantitative data, and use those insights to refine strategy, programs, and execution.

Who you are

You are a systems thinker who can connect the details of a program or product experience to the broader organizational context. You are energized by ambiguity and complexity, and thrive in bringing just enough structure, clarity, and strong momentum to the work. You build trusted relationships, communicate directly and thoughtfully, and create accountability across teams, with speed.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience building and scaling global People or HR experiences, with experience across both process and product or systems design
  • Experience leading complex programs in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where high ownership and cross-functional problem solving are expected.
  • Strong systems thinking: the ability to understand how people, processes, tools, policies, and organizational decisions influence one another over time and how to augment workflows and processes using AI tools.
  • A demonstrated ability to build enduring, trusted stakeholder relationships; communicate effectively across levels and functions; and establish clear decision-making and accountability mechanisms.
  • A disciplined approach to problem solving. You begin with the “why,” define and refine problem statements steeped in both quantitative and qualitative data, and continuously ask “is this the right problem to solve, at the right time?”
  • High agency and sound judgment. You identify opportunities or risks, take action quickly, and escalate thoughtfully when progress is blocked.
  • Deep alignment with Stripe’s Operating Principle, Obsess over Talent. You believe that people are one of Stripe’s greatest unlocks: attracting exceptional talent, creating environments where they can thrive, building systems that support growth, and recognizing meaningful contributions.
  • Curiosity and humility. You are a continuous learner who seeks to understand before acting, welcomes ideas from many sources, and is willing to change course when new evidence suggests a better path.

Preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience across a diverse portfolio of People programs: talent management, organizational development, leadership and/or executive development, program and talent operations, and compensation and benefits
  • People product design and management experience in high growth environments with fast iterative cycles, changing priorities, and a steady stream of feature requests and backlog
  • Experience and excellence leading executive level talent discussions that influence People strategy, with humility, curiosity, and a grounded presence

fields.title: Program Manager, Risk Operations GTM Enablement
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed.

We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users.

If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects.

This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management
  • Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics 
  • Bridge compliance and commercial strategy by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust
  • Build and run operating models across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable 
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations 
  • Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements 
  • Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure
  • Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first

Who you are

You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks. 

You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment 
  • Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion 
  • Exceptional communication & storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences 
  • Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks 
  • Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve

Preferred qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments 
  • Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales 
  • Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

In this role, you'll represent the Security team in audit engagements, articulate how Stripe's security controls are designed and how they operate, and ensure that compliance obligations across a complex global regulatory landscape are met with consistency and rigor.

In this role, you will act as a proxy between external entities like regulators and auditors, and our internal security teams, ensuring consistency in compliance responses and helping maintain a lean and effective compliance program.   • Support control owners with guidance on security control design and redesign to ensure continued compliance and effectiveness
  • Facilitate security compliance support for Stripe's legal entities with regulatory obligations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to track and report on control remediation efforts

We’re looking for a collaborative, action-oriented Project Manager to join the Total Rewards Strategy and Enablement team. In this role, you’ll lead business-critical People projects, with a primary focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Bringing an acquired business into Stripe requires coordinated work across Total Rewards, People Partners, Recruiting, People Operations, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development. You’ll project manage the People workstream from diligence and integration planning through close and post-close execution. You’ll turn deal-specific decisions into clear plans, ownership, milestones, and risk-management approaches.

You’ll coordinate functional owners across People workstreams, establish plans and dependencies, and step into the work when needed to unblock progress or close critical gaps. Your work will support transaction timelines, reduce business disruption, and create a consistent experience for acquired Stripes.

You’ll build People M&A’s capabilities through repeatable playbooks, infrastructure, and cross-training. This individual contributor role is well suited to someone who can bring structure to ambiguity and move between strategy and execution.

Responsibilities

  • Project manage People M&A workstreams from diligence and planning through close and post-close execution. Workstreams may include organizational alignment, employee data, onboarding, recruiting, and people program integration.
  • Serve as a central coordination point across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Operations, People Systems, Recruiting, People Support, Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Technology.
  • Align plans, dependencies, decisions, and accountability with transaction timelines.
  • Develop and run integration and change-management plans that give functional leads, acquired Stripes, and other affected audiences the information and support they need at each stage of a transaction.
  • Identify cross-functional dependencies, risks, and blockers early. Coordinate resolution and escalate issues when needed to protect integration timelines and the Stripe experience.
  • Establish feedback and support mechanisms for acquired Stripes, including surveys, office hours, and centralized support channels. Use feedback to improve integration plans and change-management approaches.
  • Build and improve People M&A’s infrastructure, including project plans, templates, checklists, playbooks, reporting, and retrospective documentation.
  • Build capability across People workstreams through documentation, cross-training, and shared practices that support more consistent future integrations.
  • Support other business-critical and transformational projects across Total Rewards and the People team as needed.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You have 7+ years of project or program management experience at a global company, including 2+ years project managing workstreams within the M&A lifecycle, including diligence, integration planning, close readiness, and post-close integration.
  • You have experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and building repeatable program infrastructure, such as integration playbooks, project-plan templates, readiness checklists, risk logs, or retrospective processes.
  • You have a track record of turning ambiguous problems into structured, repeatable programs. You’re comfortable building new programs in a scaling environment while improving and standardizing how work gets done.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can write a one-page executive update, a decision memo tailored to stakeholders, and a step-by-step operator playbook with equal fluency. You guide project teams through complex work in a direct, approachable, and inclusive way.

The Risk Partnerships team is an essential part of Stripe’s Global Partnerships organization. These banking partnerships are essential to enable Stripe to accept and make payments, provide credit, move & store money and develop new products and solutions to meet our users’ needs.
