fields.title: Strategy & Transformation Advisor (Enterprise Commerce Architecture)
fields.description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. We have a significant amount of work ahead, which gives you the opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Strategy and Transformation team

The Strategy and Transformation team helps Stripe’s largest and most strategic users define and execute high-impact business and technology transformations. We work early in the customer lifecycle, alongside account teams and senior customer leaders, to connect business ambition with a practical path to value on Stripe.

The team has established foundational Strategy and Transformation Consultant coverage across regions. We are now adding specialist advisors with differentiated expertise for enterprise conversations where Stripe’s role must be understood not simply as a payments provider, but as an integrated financial backbone within a customer’s broader commerce and technology ecosystem.

About the role

As a Strategy and Transformation Advisor, Enterprise Commerce Architecture, you will be the senior strategic advisor for complex enterprise commerce pursuits in AMER. You will help customers develop a clear, prescriptive point of view on how Stripe should fit within their future-state architecture and what that means for their commerce platforms, order management systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) and finance estate, customer and loyalty systems, identity, data platforms, fulfillment operations, and engineering organization.

This is a pre-sales role within the Strategy and Transformation Practice. You will partner with Go-to-Market (GTM), Solutions Architecture, Product, and Professional Services to increase customer confidence in Stripe’s ability to support consequential enterprise transformations. You will engage senior technical and business stakeholders, including chief technology officers, chief information officers, chief architects, vice presidents of engineering, and digital or commerce leaders. You will translate their strategic priorities into an enterprise commerce architecture, sequenced transformation roadmap, and clear implementation principles.

You will define the strategic architectural “what” and “why,” including the target state, key design principles, trade-offs, dependencies, and path to value. You will also provide technical advisory support to Stripe’s Integration Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Strategy and Transformation Consultants on the most complex opportunities.

What you will do

Shape enterprise commerce transformation strategy

  • Lead executive discovery, strategy, and architecture workshops for Stripe’s most strategic enterprise prospects and users.
  • Assess a customer’s current commerce and technology landscape. Identify how payments and financial infrastructure interact with commerce, order management, ERP and finance, customer relationship management (CRM), loyalty, identity, data, fulfillment, and risk systems. Develop a prescriptive future-state point of view for how Stripe can serve as a financial backbone within that architecture.
  • Translate business objectives, such as international expansion, omnichannel commerce, marketplace growth, subscription transformation, cost optimization, improved authorization performance, and faster product development, into clear architecture and operating model implications.
  • Define the enterprise-level principles, system boundaries, ownership models, integration patterns, data flows, and migration considerations needed to support the target state.
  • Create multi-phase, dependency-aware transformation roadmaps that connect Stripe capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

Increase confidence in strategic enterprise pursuits

  • Partner with account teams, enterprise service managers, sales leaders, and senior solutions architects to identify pursuits where enterprise commerce architecture expertise will materially improve customer confidence or decision quality.
  • Engage credibly with executive technical stakeholders as a strategic advisor and peer, rather than as a product vendor.
  • Help customers understand the practical trade-offs between their current architecture and a future state that uses Stripe more deeply.
  • Create clear executive narratives, architecture artifacts, transformation roadmaps, and decision materials that make Stripe’s role in the customer’s future state concrete.
  • Support account strategy, opportunity shaping, and value articulation for complex, multi-product enterprise pursuits.
  • Help define the path from an initial architecture vision to implementation scope, while ensuring detailed solution design and delivery ownership remain with the appropriate Stripe teams.

Advise and support Stripe’s and our users’ technical teams

  • Serve as a senior thought partner to Integration Engineers, Solutions Architects, Account Executives, and Strategy and Transformation Consultants on complex enterprise architecture questions.
  • Provide guidance on how to frame Stripe’s capabilities within broader enterprise commerce, finance, and data architectures across industries and segments, including insurance, fintech, retail, media and entertainment, marketplaces, and platforms.
  • Help user teams work through architecture-level issues, including system-of-record boundaries, application programming interface (API) and event design, data ownership, reconciliation, operational resilience, migration strategy, and organizational readiness.
  • Coach internal teams on executive technical storytelling, architecture discovery, and translating technical decisions into business value.
  • Build reusable enterprise commerce architecture frameworks, reference patterns, workshop methods, and transformation narratives that improve the team’s effectiveness across AMER.

Inform Stripe’s enterprise strategy and product direction

  • Bring recurring customer architecture patterns, friction points, and unmet needs to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership.
  • Identify emerging enterprise commerce trends, including artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled commerce and financial operations, omnichannel experiences, embedded finance, platform business models, and global expansion. Translate these trends into relevant Stripe points of view.
  • Contribute to Stripe’s differentiated perspective on enterprise commerce transformation through internal thought leadership and selective customer-facing content.

Minimum qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, technology strategy, digital transformation, management consulting, or senior technical advisory roles.
  • Significant experience advising large enterprises on complex technology transformation, ideally spanning commerce, payments, financial systems, or customer-facing platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with C-suite and vice president-level business and technical leaders.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise commerce architecture, including systems such as commerce platforms, order management, ERP and finance, CRM, loyalty, identity, fulfillment, and cloud data platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of API-first integration, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, cloud platforms, data flows, and enterprise operational models.
  • Working knowledge of payments and financial infrastructure, including acceptance, acquiring, settlement, reconciliation, fraud and risk, compliance, and multi-party payment models.
  • Ability to connect architecture decisions to business outcomes, including revenue growth, conversion, authorization performance, operational efficiency, resilience, cost, and speed to market.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to make complex architecture decisions understandable to executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional strategic engagements from initial discovery through a practical recommendation and roadmap.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Stripe or comparable payments and financial infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience in enterprise retail, marketplaces, platforms, software as a service (SaaS), travel, media, mobility, or other complex commerce environments.
  • Experience across omnichannel commerce, global payment methods, subscriptions, business-to-business payments, marketplaces, embedded finance, or platform monetization models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and methods, such as capability modeling, value stream analysis, domain-driven design, and transformation roadmapping.
  • Experience advising on data architecture, reconciliation, risk and fraud operations, AI-enabled financial operations, or commerce personalization.
  • A track record of coaching senior technical practitioners and influencing cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • External credibility through senior customer advisory work, industry speaking, publications, or contributions to enterprise technology or payments communities.

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

fields.title: Technical Program Manager, Bridge
fields.description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the team

Join our Technical Program Management team to build the systems that make global, programmable money trustworthy at scale. At Bridge, we’re not just improving global payments—we’re reinventing how money moves across borders using stablecoins and modern financial infrastructure.

This role is about driving execution across complex technical initiatives—bringing structure to ambiguous problems, aligning stakeholders, and helping the team move quickly while maintaining reliability, performance, and operational excellence.

What you’ll do

As a TPM, you'll play a key role leading complex programs across multiple engineering, product, and cross-functional (finance, legal, compliance, risk, and other) teams spanning Bridge. You'll be an active contributor to the overall strategy of the program, drive technical decision-making, and drive the execution of the program through all phases from planning to delivery. You'll have the opportunity to implement mechanisms that make your programs effective and scale them to Bridge-level processes.

Responsibilities

  • Drive functional and technical delivery of key team and org-wide programs and initiatives.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, scope, and shepherd features.
  • Create functional specs, project and release plans, and roadmaps.
  • Own and execute one or more software engineering programs simultaneously.
  • Drive product decisions that align with program and company objectives
  • Influence senior stakeholders and build consensus across engineering, product, and cross-functional teams
  • Define and scale program processes and frameworks that can be adopted across the org
  • Mentor TPMs and contribute to building the TPM discipline at Bridge

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in technical program or product management, with a consistent track record of shipping products with broad and global customer impact
  • You have a track record of providing solid program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to ship, demonstrating critical thinking and thought leadership throughout.
  • You're not satisfied with just delivering programs on time—you're discerning about product and infrastructure architecture and can lead technical discussions. You don’t let problems remain ambiguous and directly drive clarity on decision tradeoffs and solutions.
  • You operate independently and lead efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills to build relationships and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

Experience at a fintech or payments company. Track record of driving programs with cross-organizational or company-wide impact — not just team-level delivery. Comfortable working directly with senior engineering and product leadership with limited support. History of building toward durable, long-term solutions, not just shipping on time.

fields.location: Remote in the US, Chicago, Atlanta
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About our organization

The Growth organization drives Stripe's self-serve growth engine: from a user's first interaction with Stripe through onboarding, activation, and expansion across our products. Growth focuses on building the systems and surfaces that help any user find, understand, and adopt the right set of Stripe products, regardless of how or where they start.

Within Growth, the onboarding program is how new and existing users get to their first successful use of Stripe as quickly and completely as possible. A cohesive onboarding experience is critical to Stripe's ability to convert prospects, activate new products, and compete against increasingly sophisticated alternatives.

Onboarding spans several interconnected surfaces:

  1. Acquisition and intent capture — first-touch experiences that match prospects to the right products and entry points.
  2. Account setup and activation — guided flows that get users live with the right integration shape.
  3. In-product discovery — contextual surfaces that help new and existing users adopt additional products over time.

These surfaces are deeply interdependent, span dozens of cross-functional teams, and directly shape Stripe's new user activation and product attach rates.

What you’ll do

  • We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive Stripe's onboarding programs. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of growth strategy, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.
  • In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in Growth, driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's onboarding experience end-to-end. 
  • You will set the program strategy in partnership with Growth leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program. 
  • Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Growth, Dashboard, Docs, Marketing, and product teams actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
  • Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
  • Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
  • Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in product management or product operations

fields.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSE interacts directly with developer-users more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems.

What you’ll do

TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will do a wide variety of things, including explaining technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce/improve guides that help our users solve particular problems to be successful with Stripe. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe. 

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know.

If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android).
  • Unblock external developers with their thorniest integration challenges through a variety of support channels including email, ticketing software, internal issue trackers, community platforms (like StackOverflow), and real-time chat software (like Slack and Discord)
  • Develop and maintain internal and external documentation, examples, integration demos, and code-snippets that demonstrate usage patterns of the Stripe infrastructure.
  • Identify points of friction developers encounter and collaborate with engineering teams to make Stripe products better. Participate in a number of extended engineering teams’ regular planning sessions, design reviews, and development meetings.
  • Develop and maintain a suite of internal support tooling for TSE and Stripe Support more broadly e.g. a retrieval augmented generation LLM-based Copilot tool or the Invoice Explainer Admin tool.
  • Act as a developer advocate and educational resource internal to the organization by regularly assembling training for non-developers internal to the organization and responding in real-time to product integration questions.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

This role is remote but requires candidates to be located in the Mountain or Pacific time zones. 

Minimum requirements

  • At least 4 years of full-stack software development experience, with a proven track record of building web or mobile applications that deliver high-quality user experiences
  • Direct experience explaining technical concepts, and would be comfortable explaining how Stripe works to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Understands how to write good, clean code in multiple programming languages, as well as how to read code that might not be quite as well written
  • Ability to help users during working hours in the region you are in. This may occasionally include providing weekend coverage for monitoring/supporting critical infrastructure, which TSEs are uniquely equipped to assist with given the team’s knowledge around Stripe’s products and active integrations. The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met.

Preferred qualifications

  • Enjoys writing in a clear and quick manner
  • General software engineering skills are important to us, as we understand that new languages and frameworks can be learned if you understand the concepts
  • Experience teaching or coaching developers
  • Comfort working with a great deal of autonomy and limited supervision
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software/Computer Engineering, or a related analytical field of study

  • Work cross-functionally across Stripe to bring innovative ways to make Stripe’s developer experience even more self-serve & impactful.

  • Inspire, motivate and enable individual development and promote career growth of the team
  • Define, implement, and monitor key metrics that ensure the future sustainability and quality of the developer support experiences

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Experience leading, managing and developing user-facing engineering teams
  • Background in software development in one or more programming languages
  • Your immediate team is based in Singapore and Japan, with US-based management (Central Time). This role requires a work schedule that provides meaningful daily overlap with APAC business hours.   • You’re clear and persuasive in writing and in person.
  • You lead by example, by setting the right context, and by helping teammates do their best work.
  • You know when to let a team work through problems and when to jump in to help.
  • You’re technical enough to ask engineers good questions about design and integration decisions.

fields.title: Technical Support Engineer (EMEA), Metronome
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Metronome, now part of Stripe, is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.

Our platform computes millions of invoices per billing period and is scaling rapidly to accommodate new customers, saving them hours of development time and manual invoicing and enabling them to use consumption data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Confluent, and Anthropic.

What you’ll do

As a member of our technical support engineering team, you will be on the front lines providing world-class customer service. As part of our engineering organization, you will become an expert on our product and partner closely with Metronome's engineers, customer success, solutions architecture, and growth teams, as well as our customers' developers.

Your primary responsibilities will include handling customer escalations through our ticketing system, using internal observability tools to diagnose and scope customer-facing issues, collaborating directly with customers via Slack and other channels, and developing internal tools and documentation to improve the support experience. Since we view every support escalation as an opportunity to learn, both as individuals and as a company, you will play a critical role in providing feedback to our product team on common challenges and influencing our product roadmap.

Through your interactions with individual customers, you will help improve our product for everyone. Your work will play a crucial role in ensuring our customers' success and the continued effectiveness of their integration with Metronome.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical guidance to customers’ developers on best practices for integrating with our APIs and utilizing our functionality.
  • Troubleshoot any issues that arise from customers and diagnose any blockers. Escalate issues with customer context to the engineering team.
  • Develop internal tools to automate customer workflows that are currently unavailable in our product. Provide feedback on recurring patterns and advocate for addressing feature gaps in the product.
  • Design and assist in implementing a comprehensive knowledge base to assist customers with using our product.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 2+ years of work experience in a B2B customer-facing technical support organization or in engineering
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams and providing technical feedback on customer issues
  • Ability to debug and triage bugs and escalations from customers
  • Can communicate technical capabilities of the product to customers
  • Experience writing scripts or internal tools using APIs, and functional knowledge of SQL
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to break down complex technical concepts clearly
  • A mindset of customer empathy and ability to solve challenging problems

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience as an early or founding member of a support team, including building processes from scratch
  • Startup experience and familiarity with scaling a support team
  • Programming experience in one or more of Typescript, Python, or Ruby
  • You have worked on modern enterprise software which is business critical
  • Experience creating knowledge base articles and internal documentation
  • Familiarity with at least one ticketing system, such as Pylon, Zendesk, Front, or similar

fields.description:

Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and solve complex problems
  • Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
  • Work closely with other Stripe teams across the globe

  • You have experience identifying and triaging technical issues.
  • You have Python or Scala knowledge.

fields.title: [TEMPLATE] Integration Engineer (Metronome)
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Metronome is a usage-based billing platform and a Stripe product. It helps modern software companies launch products faster, offer flexible pricing models, and streamline finance workflows.

The Metronome Integration Engineering team sits at the intersection of sales, growth, product, and research and development. We own the technical aspects of the customer lifecycle after a sale and before the customer transitions to our post-implementation teams.

What you'll do

As an Integration Engineer, you’ll help customers implement Metronome successfully and realize value quickly. You’ll lead technical work across requirements gathering, solution and integration design, configuration, testing, data migration, launch, and handoff.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct discovery and scoping to understand customers’ challenges across billing, product launches, pricing and packaging, quote-to-cash, customer experience, and related areas.
  • Support customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, integration design, testing, data migration, and launch.
  • Provide expert guidance on usage-based pricing and consumption-based business models.
  • Configure Metronome’s platform on behalf of customers.
  • Design integrations between Metronome’s APIs and customers’ business systems—including CRM and CPQ platforms, payment and tax systems, ERP and billing providers, and reporting and analytics tools—in alignment with Metronome best practices.
  • Serve as a liaison between customers and Metronome’s research and development teams, advocating for customer needs and feature requests.
  • Partner with implementation managers and other project-team members to provide visibility into progress and proactively identify risks and issues.
  • Build relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives. Meet customers in person when doing so will improve the engagement.
  • Advise customers on integrating Metronome into their systems and help shape their pricing and packaging strategies.
  • Ensure an effective handoff to Customer Success and Technical Support.

You’ll work with some of Metronome’s most strategic customers. These engagements will be complex, deep, and highly technical. Metronome directly influences how modern software companies monetize their products, and this team is on the front lines of that work.

Metronome operates with a startup mindset within Stripe. There is a significant opportunity for people with initiative to influence our direction, build processes from zero to one, and make a meaningful impact.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are helpful but not required.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products, such as sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, or deployment strategy.
  • Experience leading complex implementations for enterprise technology companies.
  • Experience working in fast-moving environments that value initiative and ownership.
  • Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical concepts to technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders.
  • Interest in building and improving go-to-market playbooks, processes, and reusable assets.
  • Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, depending on customer needs.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of quote-to-cash processes, including experience integrating with or working alongside platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQ systems, and the Stripe ecosystem.
  • Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in another technical role.
  • Strong understanding of project- and program-management fundamentals.
  • Experience working with stakeholders in finance, engineering, product, sales operations, or billing operations.
  • Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, infrastructure, or financial tooling and concepts.

We are focused on assessing and managing risks exposed through our relationships with third parties, adhering to regulatory guidance, and driving operational efficiencies across risk teams. What you’ll do

Responsibilities

fields.title: University Recruiting Manager
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and create new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. The work ahead is substantial, which gives you the opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing some of the most meaningful work of your career.

About the team

Early careers is a critical part of Stripe’s long-term talent strategy. The University Recruiting team helps shape the company we become by building the systems, programs, and hiring partnerships that bring exceptional interns, apprentices, and new graduates to Stripe.

As University Recruiting Manager, you will lead and develop a team of University Recruiters while owning the strategy and delivery of intern and new graduate hiring across Stripe. This is a high-visibility leadership role with a wide stage: you will work across every line of business and role type, partner with leaders throughout the company, and turn ambitious hiring goals into thoughtful, durable programs. You will also help lead Stripe’s global internship and apprenticeship programs, including onboarding, intern experience, and employee-relations escalations.

What you’ll do

University Recruiting at Stripe is not a transactional recruiting function. This role goes well beyond attending a career fair or filling individual roles. You will set direction for an early careers strategy that supports Stripe’s business needs today and builds the talent pipeline we will need next.

You will bring strategic judgment, a builder’s mindset, and a deep commitment to craft. You will balance the operational rigor required to deliver at scale with the creativity to design programs and experiences that are clear, useful, and memorable. You will use data to understand what is working, where we are falling short, and what needs to change. And you will build credibility with leaders by making complex recruiting challenges easier to understand and act on.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of full-cycle University Recruiters. Set a high bar for judgment, execution, and candidate and hiring-team partnership.
  • Develop and deliver a clear early careers hiring strategy across Stripe’s lines of business and role families, translating business needs into practical recruiting plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with senior leaders and hiring teams across the company to understand workforce needs, influence decisions, and meet ambitious hiring goals.
  • Lead global internship and apprenticeship programs, including onboarding, intern experience, program operations, and employee-relations escalations.
  • Build and improve the end-to-end candidate experience in partnership with Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Onboarding, Legal, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Develop thoughtful university, event, employer-brand, and employee-referral strategies that strengthen Stripe’s early careers talent pipeline.
  • Use people analytics, recruiting data, and operational insights to identify patterns, measure performance, inform decisions, and improve the systems your team relies on.
  • Raise the bar for how University Recruiting works at Stripe by bringing rigor, care, and a strong point of view to both the strategy and the details.

Who you are

You are a strategic recruiting leader who sees early careers as a company-building function. You pair high standards with a practical work ethic, and you are comfortable moving from long-range planning to solving the immediate problem in front of you. You care about the quality of the work, the experience it creates for people, and the decisions behind it.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. 

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ of recruiting experience, including designing and delivering a university recruiting strategy or major early talent initiative at a high-growth or complex organization.
  • 5+ years of people management experience.
  • A proven record of leading and developing University Recruiting professionals. You give clear feedback, build strong teams, and help people grow their judgment and capability.
  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems.
  • The communication and influencing skills to earn trust with leaders at every level and turn ideas into aligned action.
  • A high degree of ownership, a rigorous work ethic, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities.
  • An appreciation for craft and beauty in the work. You care about the quality of the strategy, the programs, the candidate experience, and the operational details that make each of them work.
  • A deep interest in people analytics, with experience using recruiting metrics, tools, and process data to improve decisions and outcomes.
  • Experience partnering closely with hiring teams throughout the recruiting process as a trusted advisor.

fields.title: UX Research Manager, Payments
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. Research at Stripe

Stripe’s mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and expand economic access globally. We design tools and infrastructure to help our users start, run, and scale an online business from anywhere in the world. We believe there are too many barriers to doing business on the internet and that opportunities are not equally distributed around the world. We also believe that building and growing a business online is a problem rooted in code, language, and design, not finance.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an experienced UX Research Manager to join our growing UX Research team and help build, coach, and mentor a growing and highly skilled group of researchers.

About UX research and the role

The UX Research team is part of Stripe’s Design team. It works across brand and product initiatives to deliver products and experiences that meet user needs. Since Stripe’s main audience is people who build products, we take pride in creating user-friendly, user-focused experiences.

In addition to conducting primary research, we enable other Stripes, including engineers, product managers, designers, and operations teams, to learn and apply research skills to global problems. You will help shape research as a core competency across Stripe and define how we put users first in our research.

What you’ll do

As a UX Research Manager, you will use your people-management and research expertise to lead a team of researchers that collaborates with product teams on core Payments and Risk products to build insight-driven product experiences. Core Payments includes Stripe’s in-person and online payment capabilities, checkout suite, Radar, and smart solutions that help businesses achieve optimal payment performance while balancing regulatory requirements, conversion, costs, and fraud considerations.

You will report to the Head of Research.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, coach, and mentor a team of researchers conducting mixed-methods research throughout the product-development process for Stripe’s Payments and Risk product pillar.
  • Lead initiatives and guide the research team through artificial intelligence (AI) transformation in its internal processes, how it conducts research for Stripe users, and how it supports the changing needs of product partners.
  • Share research insights that deepen Stripe’s understanding of user needs and identify opportunities to meet those needs.
  • Grow the team to meet Stripe’s needs while developing individual contributors to deliver impactful, actionable research studies.
  • Partner with Design and Stripe leadership to determine how to best use user research at Stripe and deepen our understanding of users.
  • Work as a strategic partner to business leads, product managers, design leaders, and Stripe leadership. Define long-term strategy and short-term tactics for products by grounding decisions in user needs and insights.
  • Prioritize research needs and approaches across multiple workstreams. Select the right project, scale, and scope at the right time, and deliver actionable insights.
  • Enable other Stripes to learn and apply research skills by building research programs, platforms, and toolkits that support tactical research.
  • Partner closely with other researchers to build Stripe’s research practice and infrastructure, including sourcing research vendors to support your team’s work.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant user research experience working on digital experiences and generating actionable insights that drive impact.
  • 3+ years of people-management and leadership experience.
  • Experience directly managing, coaching, and developing a team of user researchers, as well as recruiting and building research teams.
  • Ability to set and achieve priorities that balance the needs of users, projects, the Research team, and Stripe.
  • Experience conducting project work while mentoring and supporting a team of user researchers as they develop their craft and conduct research.

Preferred qualifications

  • Relevant experience in financial technology, particularly payment processing.
  • Ability to motivate and inspire people to do their best work.
  • Experience conducting complex research at scale using a range of methods, including qualitative interviews, surveys, ideation sessions, ethnographic field research, usability evaluations, and diary studies.
  • Experience conducting primary research while mentoring and supporting a team of user researchers as they develop their craft and conduct research.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience rolling out large-scale research programs.
  • A consistent focus on users and their needs, with experience driving impact from insights.
  • Understanding of the balance between speed and rigor, and how research translates into design, product, and business decisions. Ability to work with urgency and focus while adapting methodological rigor to the situation.

fields.title: Workday Analyst
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s People Systems team sits at the intersection of technology and human experience. We are internal consultants who turn ambiguity into scalable solutions. As part of the People Solutions organization, we partner with Corporate Technology, Finance, and the wider People team, including Talent and Total Rewards, to build a world-class employee experience. We are a strategy-first, quality-focused team that values technical rigor, adaptable problem-solving, and deep empathy for the Stripes we serve.

What you’ll do

As a Workday Analyst on the People Systems team, you’ll help administer and improve Stripe’s Workday environment. You’ll support the operational, cyclical, and change-management work that keeps our systems running reliably while building technical depth across key Workday domains.

You’ll work with People Systems teammates and cross-functional partners to turn well-defined requests into tested, documented system updates. You’ll own assigned workstreams with guidance and partner with senior teammates on complex changes, high-risk decisions, and system escalations. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys solving operational problems, working carefully with confidential data, and bringing clarity to Workday administration.

Responsibilities

  • Configure and administer assigned Workday capabilities across defined functional areas, including Core Human Capital Management, Security, Time Tracking, Absence, and Reporting
  • Complete recurring operational work, including system queue monitoring, Workday Inbox support, account monitoring, access updates, routine data requests, compliance activities, and employee lifecycle processes
  • Support configuration and reporting requests through Enterprise Interface Builder loads, compensation range and grade profile updates, entity work, organizational changes, and related data maintenance
  • Conduct functional impact analyses, support daily change-management triage, and escalate complex or high-risk changes through established review paths
  • Test Workday releases, new features, configuration changes, and cyclical processes, then document results and implementation guidance
  • Triage Workday requests, gather requirements, clarify intended outcomes, resolve assigned issues, and partner with People team stakeholders on practical solutions
  • Maintain support documentation and knowledge content, identify recurring issues and system gaps, and contribute to improvements in processes and the employee experience while following applicable security, access, and audit requirements

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on Workday configuration, administration, or human resources information system experience
  • Experience configuring or supporting Workday Human Capital Management, Reporting, Security, Time Tracking, Absence, Payroll, or other employee lifecycle processes
  • Experience supporting data loads, reporting requests, system changes, testing, or operational workflows in an enterprise human resources information system environment
  • Experience working with confidential information and business-critical processes with close attention to detail
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document work, partner with stakeholders, and raise risks or blockers when needed

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams on system or process improvements
  • Experience with Workday Enterprise Interface Builders, calculated fields, and advanced, matrix, or composite reports
  • Experience supporting Workday releases, user acceptance testing, change management, or recurring People cycles
  • Workday certification or relevant Workday training
  • Experience in consulting or another role supporting internal or external clients

fields.title: Workplace Experience Manager
fields.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Workplace team’s mission is to create and support work environments that are welcoming, comfortable, and intuitive. These spaces are designed to promote collaboration, well-being, and productivity while adhering to the rigorous safety, security, and confidentiality standards required of a financial services company.

The Workplace Experience team comprises hospitality-focused professionals who partner with the business to shape the daily experiences of Stripes, visitors, and candidates across 20+ global office locations. This geographically dispersed team oversees facilities management, daily operations, and local workplace programs, including events and onsites.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a strategic leader and experienced manager with a high EQ who's enthusiastic about, and has a driving need to deliver, the best possible workplace experience for Stripes. You'll be a key member of our Experience team and responsible for ensuring that workplace operations, experiences, facilities, and programs run smoothly at our New York office. As a business partner, you have a deep understanding of the needs, experiences, and day-to-day realities of Stripes at your location and build strong relationships not only with site leads but also with cross-functional partners across the organization.

This role requires a high level of expertise and operational oversight—from understanding how the building functions top to bottom to governance of contractor team performance and ensuring financial accountability. A key part of the role is anticipating the needs of the business by understanding both the site and the broader context of company growth. You'll gather and synthesize feedback from multiple sources to ensure the workplace strategy is informed by real insights from the ground. While enterprise workplace strategy is developed centrally, you're expected to bring informed recommendations based on local business needs and operational insight, and to own successful implementation and adoption at your site.

Please note this role requires an in office presence of 4 days per week. 

Responsibilities

  • Oversee workplace operations at your site(s), providing direction on all workplace services, including building operations, front of house, shipping and receiving, events support, and employee health and safety.
  • Make sound, independent operational decisions by balancing business impact, risk, cost, and employee experience, seeking alignment when decisions create broader organizational impact or precedent.
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of workplace services professionals, providing direction, coaching, and performance management to drive team excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including senior leadership, department heads, and cross-functional teams.
  • Develop a strong rapport with locally assigned Stripes. 
  • Own operational performance for your site by monitoring service levels and utilization, identifying trends, resolving root causes, and driving continuous improvement across workplace operations.
  • Proactively anticipate business needs by understanding both local context and company priorities. 
  • Develop thoughtful, data-informed recommendations that help shape workplace programs and experiences while maintaining alignment with global standards.
  • Hold workplace partners and service providers accountable for performance, ensuring contractual obligations, service levels, and operational standards are consistently achieved while driving continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with our Finance & Strategy partner and IFM partner to develop and oversee the opex budget for all facilities, opex, fixed assets, and events of the NYC office. 
  • Work closely with the local site leadership team to activate the office by creating engagement, connection, and an inclusive environment.
  • Craft relevant communications and documentation regarding Workplace policies and programs for Stripes.
  • Ensure consistent execution of global workplace programs, standards, and policies at your site,  as developed by our Food, Space Planning, and Programs teams, adapting implementation to local operational requirements while maintaining alignment with enterprise objectives.
  • Support the Workplace team's goals by taking on ad hoc tasks and projects as they arise.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in workplace/hospitality management in a fast-paced environment with a strong customer service orientation and an understanding of operational best practices
  • Strong demonstrated ability in facilities management, vendor, and budget management
  • Strength in building relationships with key internal partners to ensure efficiency and understanding on cross-functional projects
  • Experience managing a team focused on customer service, hospitality, and operations, with the ability and desire to develop and coach your team
  • Ability to synthesize operational data, stakeholder feedback, and business context into clear recommendations that support sound decision making
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Slack and Jira
  • A clear willingness to take a hands-on approach and dive into the details
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners and translate enterprise strategy into effective local execution.
  • Ability to operate independently, digging into problems to understand the root cause and delivering scalable solutions
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced workplace with rapidly changing priorities
  • An innovative mindset with the ability to drive exceptional workplace services and operational improvements

fields.title: Account Executive, Enterprise (Paris, France)
fields.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who will play a critical role driving sales and maximizing revenue with our Enterprise customers. You will be responsible for targeting, building and nurturing positive relationships with key executive level decision-makers, understanding complex business needs, and delivering innovative solutions across our product suite. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career, learn from leading sellers in the industry and build an incredible network of cross functional partners at Figma.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Create and manage a pipeline of Enterprise accounts to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to build and strengthen relationships with key decision-makers in both new and existing customers (5000+ FTEs)
  • Align with executives on business challenges and gain sponsorship for enterprise wide deployments for a suite of products, identifying where Figma’s roadmap and innovations fit in the long term
  • Conduct thorough analysis to create strategic account plans that outline company priorities and initiatives, multi-threading at an executive level to build on expansion opportunities
  • Manage a book of business by tiering accounts and initiating techniques to save contractions
  • Co-create with cross-functional partners to expertly position Figma, drive deals forward and ensure customer success
  • Leverage opportunities to advance executive level relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience closing sales, over multiple years, for a software or SaaS business with an Enterprise book of customers (5000+ FTEs), selling to executives
  • Consistent performance meeting pipeline generation targets for net new business
  • Demonstrated experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (6 months+)
  • A sales methodology and process that creates value for customers
  • Fluency in French

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling solutions to technical audiences at a strategic level (i.e. Engineering, Product, Design teams)
  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a changing environment
  • Certified in deal qualification and prospect discovery

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

#LI-SB2

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Partner with product team and other internal staff to deliver a clear account plan that is based on understanding of client needs and provide appropriate solutions for clients across relevant products by capitalizing on bank's competitive attributes e.g. Network, balance sheet, brand etc. Identify and develop a target pipeline and aggressively market for new profitable institutional customers and exploit cross-selling opportunities. Gather information that is needed to prepare and assess credit applications in order to manage customer expectations. Manage the development of prudently priced assets, cost-effective long-term liability with reputable institutions and organizations in order to ensure Bank's maximum profitability. Identify and take ownership of sales leads generated for the bank; Ecosystem banking – Corporate Banking, Business Banking and Retail Banking Manage the product partners to ensure that work standards and quality work output targets are set, achieved and maintained. Fluent in verbal and written communication in English and Swahili. Strong in numerical skills and financial acumen to analyze, evaluate and identify trends in complex consolidated financial statements, balance sheets and ratios, Persuasive - Enjoys selling and negotiating, changes the opinions of others, is convincing with arguments. fields.description: Job Purpose: To manage and grow the Salaried Workers Loan (SWL) portfolio within Local Government Authorities and Central Government Ministries by deepening penetration, strengthening institutional relationships, and ensuring sustainable portfolio growth and quality. Main Responsibilities: Identify and pursue growth opportunities within Local Government Authorities and Central Government Ministries. Deepen penetration in assigned Government schemes through regular engagement with key decision makers, HR, payroll and other relevant Government officials. Conduct structured employer visits, presentations, sales activations and financial literacy sessions to promote SWL and other relevant Personal Banking solutions Build, strengthen and maintain sustainable relationships with Government decision makers and key officials to support business continuity, customer access and portfolio growth Prepare and implement scheme penetration plans with measurable milestones for each assigned Local Government and Central Government institution. Provide leadership, coaching and day-to-day business support to Direct Sales Staff (DSS) and the Branch Network to achieve SWL acquisition and disbursement targets. Conduct joint field visits with DSS and branch teams to Government employers, ensuring effective customer acquisition, product promotion and onboarding. Ensure DSS and branch teams adhere to compliance standards, ethical sales practices and accuracy of customer and loan documentation Monitor the SWL portfolio across assigned Local and Central Government schemes to deliver sustainable growth, portfolio quality and minimal NPLs. Engage relevant Government/payroll stakeholders on payroll deductions, reconciliations, arrears and other scheme-related matters to support timely resolution and portfolio quality Identify, assess and escalate risks or operational issues affecting assigned Government schemes and coordinate proactive resolution with relevant internal and external stakeholders Prepare accurate daily, weekly and monthly performance reports covering assigned Government schemes, DSS/branch productivity, pipeline, disbursements and portfolio quality. Conduct competitor and market analysis, capture customer and employer feedback, and recommend improvements to products, processes, pricing and market positioning Knowledge and Skills: Sound knowledge of Retail and Personal Banking products and services, with strong understanding of Salaried Workers Lending. Sound knowledge of lending policies, credit procedures, portfolio quality management, operational risk and compliance requirements. High level of initiative, accountability, adaptability and ability to execute in a high-pressure environment. fields.title: Senior Analyst; Client Origination
fields.description: Job Purpose: To evaluate counter-party credit risks associated with Wholesale Banking lending at the client interface, with the primary objective to contain credit risk within acceptable parameters. Responsible to develop and maintain close relationships with the broader lending, Structured Trade finance and co-financier community with a view to facilitating the syndication and co-financing of sovereign (public sector) and non-sovereign (private sector) borrowing customers and originate and execute transactions across Wholesale Banking customers. Main Responsibilities: Strategic Focus Provide direct (specialist/ professional) credit evaluation services at the customer interface and apprise client application timely within short Turn Around Time. Identify credit and risk management requirements at the source of the deal negotiation/ business proposal. Conduct credit evaluation interviews during deal negotiation to obtain sufficient and appropriate information to evaluate business risk and deal viability, from a credit risk perspective. Decline non-viable deals at source, however, work in partnership with Head, Wholesale Client Origination, Relationship Managers and clients to identify alternatives that could bring deals/ proposals within risk acceptable parameters relative to profitability. Support other team members in the department to develop high quality credit solutions to customers and recommend appropriate facilities in line with risk evaluation with the view of obtaining fast credit approval from credit decision makers. Present and defend own judgement and senior credit evaluations to clients in a manner that does not negatively affect the business relationship. Identify, quantify and evaluate sources of risk in relation to profitability of business proposal and financial viability of the corporation as a whole; interrogate/review information obtained to gain a thorough understanding of business parameters which create profit/ value as well as the associated risks. Utilize industry risk analysis available to identify and understand contextual threats to existing and potential clients. Evaluate whether proposals meet sound business criteria and counter-party credit risk falls within acceptable parameters, and recommends appropriate business credit facilities, including terms or conditions of facilities. Prepare credit applications providing sound financial and business justification for deals/ proposals within acceptable risk parameters relative to profitability. Present and defend credit proposals to Management and Board Credit Committees to seek their support. Operational Focus Proactively and timely processing of credit applications for existing facilities ensuring consistent, thorough and timely submission within the agreed Turn Around Time. Detect and evaluate shifts or changes in key parameters in a business relationship or industry and evaluate the implications of such changes on continued business dealings. Analyze information received from clients and the client's performance. Establish reasons for risk exposure in excess of credit facilities; evaluate these in relation to business risk parameters. Monitor utilization in excess or arrears of credit facilities and assist Relationship Managers in managing the risk exposure. Review the financials and non-financials of the customer and advise the Relationship Manager and customer on revision before processing the credit facility. Review the financial and non-financials of the customer and advise the Relationship Manager and customer for revision before the process of Credit Facility. Review the correctness of data and information obtained including financials & Risk Return Based pricing and Risk Grading calculations before submission to decision maker. Build relationships with Credit Originators and Relationship Managers to improve the quality of business proposals and turnaround time on credit evaluations. Share joint credit responsibility with business. Understand the implications of substandard delivery. Ensure full availability of service to the wholesale team. Identify risks/ barriers to business development that emanate from a client's operating environment and develop strategies to mitigate/ overcome these challenges with the relevant members of the team and the Client. Monitor and Control quality of portfolio using ‘Condition of Sanction' triggers where possible. Discuss with Sanctioners about deteriorating trends and trigger events if they give cause for concern and advising the Relationship Manager simultaneously. Plan and implement annual credit reviews for the portfolio. Monitor daily referrals to ensure that clients' facilities are managed within the parameters set by credit exercising discretion regarding account conduct based on a close knowledge and understanding of client activities. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Coach Relationship Managers and the credit origination team in all aspects of daily work and ensure that team communication is open and ongoing. Ensure that the bank is up to date with the Client's existing business and possible opportunities and risks, personal and business needs and preferences. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of the key areas in Wholesale Banking. Understanding of key financial indicators and usage of financial analysis to evaluate strategic options and opportunities. Robust credit knowledge Strong ability to influence, build and /or initiate effective relationships and credibility with others (colleagues, stakeholders and customers). Ability to identify, clarify/define and work through challenges towards a defined outcome Reflect high levels of accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to think in terms of integrated solutions; logical, rational and shows sound judgement. Excellent communication skills, both verbally and in writing with the ability to listen actively and with interest and interrogate and interpret information effectively. Ability to effectively and strategically influence across the organization. Advanced negotiation skills Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related fields. Master's degree in business studies is an added advantage Postgraduate education in Banking and/or Banking certification(s) is an added advantage. At least 4 years' experience in Credit origination or evaluation. Experience in project structuring, financial modeling, validation and reviewing financial statements.
