fields.title: Senior Manager; Business Insights & Analytics
fields.description: Job Purpose: Act as a Bank analytics partner to the business, turning data into decisions that leadership and the business units can act on. Responsible to own the business side of data, what the business needs from it, and the analysis, models, dashboards, and insight built on top of it. Closely working with all business and reporting tools. Main Responsibilities: Business Unit Partnership & Demand Management Act as the single point of contact for analytics across the business units understanding each units commercial objectives, agreeing an analytics agenda with each Business Head, and keeping it aligned to the Banks strategy. Gather, challenge, and consolidate data and reporting demand from across the business into a single prioritized pipeline, so that scarce engineering capacity goes to the highest-value work rather than to whoever asks loudest. Agree service expectations with business stakeholders on what will be delivered, to what quality, by when and manage expectations honestly when trade-offs are required. Embed analytics into business routines, this entails performance reviews, planning cycles, product launches, and campaign post-mortems. Coordination of Data Engineering & Technical Capability (CTOs Team) Translate business questions into clear, unambiguous technical requirements — data sources, definitions, granularity, refresh frequency, and acceptance criteria — for the CTOs data engineering, platform, and architecture teams. Coordinate and sequence the Banks data engineering demand with the CTOs teams joint prioritization, delivery planning, dependency management, and escalation where timelines or quality are at risk. Act as business owner and acceptance authority for data products delivered by technology such as pipelines, data marts, semantic layers, and reporting infrastructure, signing off only when they meet the businesss stated requirements. Work with the CTOs teams to drive down data latency, moving, processing and reporting from D1 towards near real time, and to raise the level of automation, scheduled jobs, robust pipelines, and self-serve reporting so manual effort falls across both functions. Contribute the business perspective to data architecture, tooling, and platform decisions, so that what is built serves how the Bank runs. Maintain a shared view of data definitions and business logic between the business and technology, so there is one trusted version of the truth and business units are not reconciling competing numbers. Business Intelligence, Monitoring & Reporting Define the requirements for, and own the business content of, real-time monitoring dashboards that detect transaction spikes and dips, liquidity and float shortages across channels, and fraud or anomaly patterns, protecting service uptime, customer experience, and revenue, and cutting incident response times. Design and maintain the Banks management dashboards and self-serve reporting layer, working on the platforms provided and supported by the CTOs teams. Prepare analytics inputs for Management, Board, and regulatory reporting cycles to the required standard and timelines. Performance Tracking & Insight Generation Serve as the central resource for business analytics track and report on all active and launched strategic initiatives and projects and coordinate the collection and assembly of annual operating plans and budgets. Produce scorecards and ranking tables for business performance by segment, product, channel, region, branch, and relationship team highlighting deviations from target, developing hypotheses in consultation with departmental heads, and proactively raising red flags on initiatives that are not meeting objectives. Propose data-based amendments to strategies and initiatives to enhance or accelerate the attainment of business objectives. Conduct regular and ad-hoc deep-dive analyses to explain trends that are not immediately understood across the business. Support business case development and post-implementation reviews for major initiatives with credible, evidence-based numbers. Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modelling Lead the development of predictive and optimization models that lift profitability, operational efficiency, and customer experience including deposit and liquidity forecasting, transaction volume forecasting, channel capacity planning, and pricing and yield optimization. Identify new opportunities to apply machine learning and statistical modelling to commercial problems customer attrition and churn prediction, cross-sell and up-sell propensity, customer lifetime value, next-best-action, credit risk and collections analytics, and fraud and anomaly detection. Work with the CTOs teams on the deployment, hosting, and ongoing monitoring of models in production, with clear ownership of model performance and business outcomes retained by this role. Partner with Risk and Credit teams to ensure models developed within the analytics function meet the Banks model governance, validation, and documentation standards. Team Leadership & Analytics Delivery Lead and manage the Strategy analytics team - Data Analysts and Data Scientists delivering end-to-end analytical solutions on top of the data platforms provided by technology. Set the teams priorities, development plans, and performance standards; recruit, coach, and retain strong analytics talent. Promote a data-driven culture across the Bank by aligning analytics outputs with strategic objectives, and by building analytical capability within the business units themselves so decisions at executive level are faster and better informed. Data Quality, Governance & Compliance Act as business data steward for the analytics domain, own business data definitions, quality rules, and reconciliation standards, and work with the CTOs teams to have them enforced at source and in the pipelines. Ensure data quality and integrity by implementing rigorous reconciliation processes for financial and management reporting and for audits, in line with regulatory and industry requirements, including Bank of Tanzania regulations and applicable data protection legislation. Define and maintain process compliance, standard operating procedures, and data policies for the analytics function; coordinate with Internal Audit and Controls to confirm testing adherence. Safeguard responsible data handling, access controls, customer data privacy and confidentiality, and documentation, across the analytics function, in line with the security standards set by technology. Knowledge and Skills: Strong SQL and hands-on experience with at least one analytics language (Python and R) - enough to build and to interrogate what others have built. BI and visualization tools - Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Superset, or similar. Sufficient working knowledge of data pipeline and workflow tooling (e.g. Airflow, dbt, or equivalent ETL frameworks) to write credible requirements, review designs, and hold engineering delivery to account. Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts, data modelling, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Familiarity with machine learning workflows - from feature engineering through model deployment and monitoring. Understanding core banking, card, and digital channel data structures is an added advantage Qualifications and Experience: Bachelors degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Track execution against the Medium-Term Plan (MTP) and annual strategy. Identify execution risks, delays and bottlenecks and escalate key issues appropriately. fields.description:
Research Data Collection Assistant – 13 Posts

Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS)

Location: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania

Employment Type: Full-Time, Project-Based Contract

Contract Duration: Two (2) Years

Number of Positions: 13

Application Deadline: 12th October 2026

About Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS)

The Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS) is a Tanzanian premium health and allied sciences university established in 2007 through Article 1 of the Charter of Incorporation in line with the Universities Act No. 7 of 2005.

Since its establishment, MUHAS has developed a range of programmes in biomedical, clinical and allied health sciences. The University conducts teaching, research and other academic activities across seven Schools and one academic Institute.

Job Summary

The Probiotic Study is a Hybrid Type II effectiveness-implementation research study led by MUHAS through the Department of Paediatrics and Child Health.

The study will evaluate whether multistrain probiotic supplementation — Labinic Drops, containing B. infantis, L. acidophilus NCFM, and B. bifidum Bb-06 — at 0.2 ml once daily for 30 days can be effectively and safely delivered within routine neonatal care for low birth weight (LBW), late preterm and term infants across nine health facilities in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

A total of 5,810 neonates will be enrolled across three hub-and-spoke clusters:

- Temeke: Temeke RRH, Mbagala Rangi Tatu DH and Yombo Vituka HC

- Ilala: Amana RRH, Kivule DH and Buguruni HC

- Kinondoni: Mwananyamala RRH, Mabwepande DH and Sinza HC

The study will generate evidence to support national policy on probiotic supplementation for LBW neonates and contribute to reducing neonatal morbidity and mortality from serious bacterial infections in Tanzania and across sub-Saharan Africa.

District Assignments

Temeke District

- Temeke RRH

- Mbagala Rangi Tatu DH

- Yombo Vituka HC

Ilala District

- Amana RRH

- Kivule DH

- Buguruni HC

Kinondoni District

- Mwananyamala RRH

- Mabwepande DH

- Sinza HC

Duties and Responsibilities

The Research Data Collection Assistant will be responsible for:

- Identifying eligible LBW neonates with a birth weight of 1,500–2,500 g, gestational age of 34–42 weeks including term babies, and age of 3–7 days from the daily delivery register, and completing the REDCap Q1 Screening and Eligibility Log daily.

- Approaching parents/guardians of eligible neonates, administering the full informed consent process and completing the REDCap Q2 Enrolment and Baseline Form. Antibiotic use at enrolment does not exclude a neonate.

- Administering the first dose of Labinic Drops (0.2 ml) at the facility, training caregivers on home administration and diary completion, and supplying a 30-day course of Labinic Drops.

- Conducting EPI-aligned follow-up visits at 6 weeks, 10 weeks, 14 weeks, 9 months and 18 months of age, recording growth measurements, PSBI screening and antibiotic use, and completing the REDCap Q4 Follow-up Visit Form.

- Screening every enrolled neonate at every contact for PSBI signs using the WHO/UNICEF IMCI checklist and immediately triggering the PSBI Investigation Form (Q5) if any sign is identified.

- Collecting stool and blood samples from sub-cohort neonates at Day 0, 6 weeks and 18 months, and arranging transportation to the MUHAS central laboratory.

- Administering the ASQ-3 neurodevelopmental assessment to caregivers of sub-cohort neonates at 6, 9 and 18 months corrected age.

- Completing all REDCap data entry accurately and in real time using the facility tablet or REDCap Mobile App, including offline data entry and automatic synchronisation.

- Reporting any Adverse Events (AEs) or Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) to the District Coordinator immediately.

- Attending all study-related trainings, GCP refreshers and clinical meetings.

About Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS)

The Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS) is a Tanzanian premium health and allied sciences university established in 2007 through Article 1 of the Charter of Incorporation in line with the Universities Act No. 7 of 2005.

Since its establishment, MUHAS has developed a range of programmes in biomedical, clinical and allied health sciences. The University conducts teaching, research and other academic activities across seven Schools and one academic Institute.

Job Summary

The Probiotic Study is a Hybrid Type II effectiveness-implementation research study led by MUHAS through the Department of Paediatrics and Child Health.

The study will evaluate whether multistrain probiotic supplementation — Labinic Drops, containing B. infantis, L. acidophilus NCFM, and B. bifidum Bb-06 — at 0.2 ml once daily for 30 days can be effectively and safely delivered within routine neonatal care for low birth weight (LBW), late preterm and term infants across nine health facilities in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

A total of 5,810 neonates will be enrolled across three hub-and-spoke clusters:

- Temeke: Temeke RRH, Mbagala Rangi Tatu DH and Yombo Vituka HC

- Ilala: Amana RRH, Kivule DH and Buguruni HC

- Kinondoni: Mwananyamala RRH, Mabwepande DH and Sinza HC

The study will generate evidence to support national policy on probiotic supplementation for LBW neonates and contribute to reducing neonatal morbidity and mortality from serious bacterial infections in Tanzania and across sub-Saharan Africa.

Kinondoni District

- Mwananyamala RRH

- Mabwepande DH

- Sinza HC

- Identifying eligible LBW neonates with a birth weight of 1,500–2,500 g, gestational age of 34–42 weeks including term babies, and age of 3–7 days from the daily delivery register, and completing the REDCap Q1 Screening and Eligibility Log daily.

- Collecting stool and blood samples from sub-cohort neonates at Day 0, 6 weeks and 18 months, and arranging transportation to the MUHAS central laboratory.

- Administering the ASQ-3 neurodevelopmental assessment to caregivers of sub-cohort neonates at 6-, 9- and 18-month corrected ages.

- Completing all REDCap data entry accurately and in real time using the facility tablet or REDCap Mobile App, including offline data entry and automatic synchronisation.

fields.description:
Department: DEPARTMENT OF RETAIL BANKING

Employment Terms: PERMANENT

Job Purpose
The Business Intelligence Analyst Digital Products is responsible for driving commercial and product performance insights across the digital banking portfolio. This role focuses on analyzing customer behavior, product adoption, revenue generation and campaign effectiveness. By deeply exploring transaction data, the analyst will identify customer segments, predict product churn and uncover opportunities to maximize the lifetime value of digital banking products, providing the core insights needed by product managers to optimize their roadmaps.

Key Responsibilities
- Monitor and report on key product metrics including transaction value/volume, fee revenue, margin analysis and monthly active product users.

- Evaluate the performance of specific digital products (e.g., Merchant Payments, Utility bill payments, Transfers etc.) against targets and historical trends.

- Analyze the direct revenue and cost structures of digital products to identify low-performing features or high-margin growth opportunities.

- Segment the digital banking customer base based on transaction frequency, product cross-holdings and value tiering to identify usage patterns.

- Track product dormancy and build analytical views to help identify customers at risk of abandoning specific digital services.

- Partner with marketing and product growth teams to measure the Return on Investment (ROI) and customer uptake of product promotions and feature rollouts.

- Design and maintain commercial, business-facing dashboards (using Power BI, Tableau or any other relevant tool) that give Product Owners a clear view of product health and customer trends.

- Work under the BI Manager to ensure commercial metrics (e.g., "Active Merchants", "Revenues per User") are modelled accurately and consistently from the raw data warehouse layers.

- Conduct deep-dive analyses to answer specific commercial questions, such as "Why are merchant payments dropping in a specific sub-segment?"

- Package internal product usage data to support business development teams when establishing partnerships with corporate merchants or fintech integrators

Qualifications & Requirements
- Bachelors degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, or a related quantitative commercial field.

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in data analytics, financial analysis, or commercial BI, with a strong preference for experience in Retail Banking, Mobile Money, Fintech, or E-Commerce.

- Strong capability in writing SQL queries to extract, aggregate, and join complex transaction data tables and customer profile records.

- Minimum of 2 years of experience designing insightful, business-oriented dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase, with advanced skills in data manipulation and rapid spreadsheet modeling for quick commercial lookups.

- Strong working knowledge of Python (Pandas/NumPy) or R for cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and statistical modeling.

- Ability to see past the raw numbers to understand the business impact, customer pain points, and financial drivers behind data trends, with exceptional capability to translate complex behavioral data into simple visual charts and highly actionable business recommendations.

- Comfortable embedding with non-technical Product Managers to understand their goals and proactively supply the data they need.

- Flexible and adaptive to market dynamics and experimentation, with a customer-centric mindset.

fields.title: SENIOR SPECIALIST FUND OPERATIONS
fields.description:
Department: DEPARTMENT OF TREASURY

Employment Terms: PERMANENT

Job Purpose
To manage the end-to-end investor operations of all managed funds and Collective Investment Schemes, including on-boarding, KYC and Customer Due Diligence, subscriptions, allocation of units, repurchases, account maintenance, and unit holder registry control. The role ensures that each investor instruction is complete, authorized, processed at the correct price, reconciled, communicated, and supported by a complete audit trail.

Key Responsibilities
- Receive and review applications from individual, joint, minor, corporate, institutional, trust, and other permitted investor categories using approved on-boarding requirements.

- Perform Know Your Customer verification and Customer Due Diligence, including identification, legal status, beneficial ownership, authorised signatories, contact details, bank information, source of funds, risk classification, sanctions screening, and politically exposed person screening; perform periodic and event-driven KYC reviews and follow up on expired, missing, or changed client information.

- Refer high-risk, unusual, incomplete, or potentially suspicious cases to Compliance or the appropriate approving authority and do not activate accounts before all required approvals are obtained.

- Create and maintain investor accounts in the fund administration and registry systems and ensure that each record is complete, accurate, current, and supported by retrievable documentation.

- Receive and validate subscription instructions against cleared funds, investor account details, product eligibility, minimum investment requirements, applicable cut-off times, and required approvals.

- Match incoming funds to investor instructions using approved payment references and investigate unmatched, unidentified, returned, or unallocated funds promptly.

- Calculate and allocate units using the approved NAV and applicable issue-price rules, subject to maker-checker review and final approval; record subscriptions and unit allotments in the registry system, update units in issue, and issue confirmations or statements within approved timelines.

- Maintain a complete subscription and unit-allocation audit trail linking the application, payment, NAV, units allocated, approval, and client confirmation.

- Receive and validate repurchase requests, confirm ownership and available units, verify signatures and payment details, and apply the relevant cut-off and repurchase-price rules; calculate units to be cancelled and repurchase proceeds, including any approved fees or taxes, and prepare payment instructions for authorised review and release.

- Process switches, transfers, changes of investor particulars, bank-detail amendments, mandates, pledges, freezes, and other permitted registry transactions using the required controls.

- Monitor pending repurchases and other instructions through completion and promptly escalate documentation, liquidity, payment, fraud, or service-level issues; issue transaction confirmations and maintain evidence linking each instruction, approval, unit cancellation or change, payment, and client communication.

- Maintain the official unitholder register, including investor details, units held, transaction history, account status, mandates, restrictions, and distribution instructions.

fields.title: MANAGER FUND ADMINISTRATION AND OPERATIONS
fields.description:
Department: DEPARTMENT OF TREASURY

Employment Terms: PERMANENT

Job Purpose
To lead the administration and operational control of all managed funds and Collective Investment Schemes, ensuring accurate and timely NAV approval, complete fund accounting, effective investor servicing, reliable unit registry records, and compliant processing of subscriptions and repurchases. The role is accountable for the quality of work produced by Fund Accounting and Fund Operations and for maintaining clear segregation of duties across investment management, fund administration, custody, settlement, and distribution.

Key Responsibilities
- Establish and maintain the operating framework, procedures, service standards, cut-off times, and control checklists for fund administration and investor transactions.

- Plan and oversee daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual fund administration activities so that NAVs, investor transactions, reconciliations, statements, and reports are completed within approved timelines.

- Review operational exceptions, delayed transactions, unmatched funds, pricing issues, and client-impacting incidents; approve corrective action and escalate material matters promptly.

- Coordinate operational activities with Investment Management, Sales, Compliance, Risk, Information and Communication Technology, custodians, trustees, banks, auditors, and other service providers.

- Review and approve daily or periodic Net Asset Value calculations and unit prices prepared by the Senior Specialist Fund Accounting in accordance with scheme documents, approved valuation policies, International Financial Reporting Standards, and regulatory requirements.

- Ensure that approved pricing sources, valuation hierarchies, accrual methods, fee rates, and corporate-action treatments are applied consistently across all funds; review unusual NAV movements, stale or unavailable prices, valuation overrides, and NAV errors; ensure that each exception is documented, independently checked, corrected, and reported where required.

- Oversee the preparation of fund financial statements, management accounts, expense reports, Total Expense Ratio calculations, and supporting schedules.

- Oversee investor on-boarding, Know Your Customer checks, Customer Due Diligence, account maintenance, subscriptions, unit allocations, switches, transfers, distributions, and repurchases processed by the Senior Specialist Fund Operations; ensure that units are issued or cancelled only after the required documentation, cleared funds, applicable NAV, cut-off rules, approvals, and maker-checker controls have been confirmed.

- Maintain oversight of the unitholder register and ensure that total units in issue reconcile to fund accounting records and approved NAV calculations.

- Monitor turnaround times rejected or incomplete applications, unallocated cash, repurchase payments, investor complaints, and recurring service issues.

- Ensure timely reconciliation of cash, investment holdings, unsettled trades, income, expenses, units in issue, and investor balances across the fund administration system, general ledger, custodian records, bank statements, and investment records; review aged reconciliation items and assign clear owners and resolution dates; escalate material or recurring breaks to the Senior Manager Fund Management and relevant control functions.

- Oversee payment and settlement instructions relating to investments, fund expenses, distributions, and repurchases, subject to delegated authority and dual-control requirements; coordinate liquidity information and expected investor cash flows with Investment Management without assuming responsibility for portfolio investment decisions.

- Ensure that fund administration activities comply with Capital Markets and Securities Authority requirements, Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism obligations, scheme constitutive documents, tax requirements, and approved internal policies; oversee periodic regulatory returns and operational disclosures and confirm that submissions are accurate, complete, reviewed, and filed within the required timelines.

- Maintain an effective operational risk and control framework covering NAV errors, transaction errors, fraud, data quality, cyber and system incidents, business continuity, and third-party service failures; coordinate internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, evidence requests, management responses, and timely closure of agreed actions.

- Act as the business owner for fund administration, fund accounting, and registry systems, including access controls, data integrity, change approval, user acceptance testing, and business continuity arrangements.

- Monitor the performance of custodians, trustees, banks, registrars, technology providers, and other operational counter-parties against contracts and agreed service levels; lead automation and process-improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, strengthen controls, shorten processing times, and improve the investor experience.

- Supervise, coach, and evaluate the Senior Specialist Fund Accounting and Senior Specialist Fund Operations, setting clear objectives and review standards for each role.

- Maintain appropriate segregation of duties, work allocation, leave coverage, succession arrangements, and cross-training for critical fund administration activities.

- Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in fund administration, fund accounting, custody, investment operations, asset management operations, or financial services.

- Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience in fund administration, fund accounting, investment operations, custody operations, or a related financial services environment.

fields.title: SENIOR SPECIALIST FUND ACCOUNTING
fields.description:
Department: DEPARTMENT OF TREASURY

Employment Terms: PERMANENT

Job Purpose
To compute accurate and timely Net Asset Values and maintain complete accounting records for all managed funds and Collective Investment Schemes. The role accounts for investments, income, expenses, assets, and liabilities; performs independent reconciliations; prepares financial and regulatory reports; and maintains a clear audit trail for every reported NAV and fund balance.

Key Responsibilities
- Prepare daily or periodic Net Asset Value calculations and unit prices for each fund in accordance with scheme documents, approved valuation policies, International Financial Reporting Standards, and regulatory requirements.

- Obtain and validate prices, yields, exchange rates, accrual data, and other valuation inputs from approved independent sources.

- Value equities, government and corporate debt securities, money-market instruments, deposits, accrued income, receivables, payables, and other permitted assets and liabilities using the approved methodology.

- Calculate units in issue, total net assets, NAV per unit, offer or issue prices, and repurchase prices where applicable, and submit the complete NAV pack for review and approval.

- Analyse NAV and price movements against prior periods, market movements, cash flows, income, expenses, and tolerance thresholds; investigate and document unusual variances before release; maintain evidence of source prices, calculations, overrides, reviews, approvals, and corrections for each NAV cycle.

- Maintain the general ledger and subsidiary records for each fund in accordance with approved accounting policies and the applicable chart of accounts.

- Record investment purchases, sales, maturities, settlements, corporate actions, income receipts, distributions, subscriptions, repurchases, and other fund transactions accurately and in the correct period.

- Calculate and record interest, dividends, premiums or discounts, realised and unrealised gains and losses, withholding taxes, management fees, custodian fees, trustee fees, audit fees, and other fund expenses.

- Prepare monthly, interim, and annual trial balances, management accounts, financial statements, cash-flow information, and supporting schedules in accordance with applicable financial-reporting requirements; ensure that accounting policies, estimates, classifications, and disclosures are applied consistently and that any change is approved and documented.

- Perform daily reconciliations of cash, investment holdings, unsettled trades, income, expenses, receivables, payables, and valuation records across the general ledger, fund administration system, custodian statements, bank statements, and investment records; reconcile total units in issue and investor transaction totals to the unitholder register maintained by Fund Operations.

- Investigate reconciling items promptly, document the cause and resolution, obtain the required approval for corrections, and escalate aged or material differences; maintain complete reconciliation schedules, supporting evidence, reviewer sign-offs, and an aged-items tracker for audit and management review.

- Calculate management, trustee, custodian, registrar, audit, regulatory, and other approved fees in line with contracts, scheme documents, and applicable caps or rates; monitor fund expenses against approved budgets and Total Expense Ratio limits and report actual or forecast breaches.

- Prepare tax computations, withholding-tax schedules, returns, and payment support within assigned responsibilities, and coordinate technical matters with Finance or tax advisers.

- Calculate distributable income and prepare accounting schedules for income distributions, subject to review and approval.

- Prepare accounting, valuation, NAV, portfolio, and expense information required for management, trustees, custodians, auditors, regulators, and investor reports.

- Prepare audit working papers, confirmations, lead schedules, valuation evidence, and responses to audit queries within agreed timetables; support regulatory inspections and implement assigned audit or control actions by the agreed due dates.

- Apply maker-checker controls and ensure that journals, master-data changes, price overrides, fee changes, and accounting adjustments are properly supported and authorised.

- Maintain accurate static data, valuation parameters, fee tables, accounting mappings, and reporting configurations within authorised access rights; participate in system implementation, user acceptance testing, process automation, and procedure updates affecting fund accounting and NAV production.

- Protect fund and investor information and retain accounting and NAV records in accordance with approved retention requirements.

Qualifications & Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, Commerce, Investment Management, or a related field.

- Professional certifications such as CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent recognized professional accounting qualification will be an added advantage.

- Minimum of 4 years of relevant accounting experience, including practical experience in fund accounting, asset management, custody, investment operations, or another investment-related environment.

- Demonstrated experience in computing Net Asset Values (NAVs), accounting for financial instruments, preparing financial statements, and performing multi-source reconciliations.

- Practical knowledge of fund accounting, investment accounting, fund valuation, portfolio accounting, and financial reporting processes.

- Strong working knowledge of applicable International Financial Reporting Standards, particularly the accounting and valuation requirements for financial instruments.

- Knowledge of capital markets products and the Tanzanian capital markets regulatory and tax environment.

- Proficiency in accounting, fund administration, spreadsheet, and reporting systems, with strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

fields.title: DATA SCIENTIST
fields.description:
Department: DATA MANAGEMENT OFFICE

Employment Terms: PERMANENT

Job Purpose
The Data Scientist is responsible for designing, developing, validating, deploying, and continuously improving data science and machine learning solutions that deliver measurable business value in banking, while complying with the Bank’s AI governance, model risk management, data governance, information security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. The role ensures models and analytical solutions are accurate, explainable, fair, secure, well-documented, and fit for purpose throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement predictive, prescriptive, and optimization models for priority banking use cases such as fraud detection, credit risk assessment, collections, customer analytics, and operational efficiency.

- Translate business problems into data science use cases, define success criteria with stakeholders, and ensure proposed solutions align with approved business objectives and governance requirements.

- Perform data exploration, feature engineering, model training, testing, and performance evaluation using sound statistical and machine learning techniques.

- Prepare complete model documentation, including business rationale, methodology, assumptions, data sources, feature definitions, limitations, performance metrics, and implementation considerations, to support review, approval, audit, and regulatory scrutiny.

- Ensure models are developed and maintained in line with the Bank’s AI governance framework, model risk management standards, data governance requirements, responsible AI principles, and applicable regulatory obligations.

- Support model validation and approval processes by providing transparent documentation, reproducible development artefacts, evidence of testing, and clear explanations of model logic, outputs, and limitations.

- Assess and mitigate risks relating to model bias, unfair outcomes, data quality, privacy, explainability, robustness, and misuse, and escalate material issues through the appropriate governance channels.

- Collaborate with Data Engineering, MLOps, IT, Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Internal Audit, and business teams to ensure controlled deployment, integration, monitoring, and change management for analytical solutions.

- Monitor models and analytical solutions in production for performance, stability, drift, fairness, and operational effectiveness, and recommend recalibration, retraining, rollback, or retirement where required.

- Maintain version control, traceability, and audit trails for datasets, code, experiments, model versions, approvals, and production changes in accordance with internal standards.

- Apply appropriate controls for data confidentiality, customer privacy, access management, and secure handling of sensitive information throughout the model lifecycle.

- Contribute to model inventories, periodic reviews, performance reporting, and governance forums by providing timely updates on model status, issues, risks, and remediation actions.

- Support experimentation with advanced techniques such as time-series forecasting, natural language processing, and deep learning where justified by business need, data readiness, and governance approval.

- Promote a culture of responsible, ethical, and evidence-based use of AI and analytics across the organisation, including knowledge sharing and adherence to approved standards and practices.

Qualifications & Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.

- Minimum of 3 years experience in machine learning, statistical modeling, or data analysis.

- Professional certifications in Azure AI, Data Science, MLOps, and Responsible AI are mandatory.

- Master’s degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, Statistics, Business Analytics, or an MBA with a specialization in Analytics will be an added advantage.

- Demonstrated experience in machine learning, data engineering, AI governance, and business value realization.

- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

- Strong understanding of statistics, probability, and data science principles.

- Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to communicate insights effectively.

- Familiarity with cloud-based machine learning solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Job Purpose
The Feature Engineering Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and continuously improving features and feature pipelines that support accurate and reliable machine learning solutions and deliver measurable business value in banking, while complying with the Bank’s AI governance, model risk management, data governance, information security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. The role ensures features the data inputs used by models are relevant, reusable, traceable, well-documented, and consistent between model development and operational use throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain features and feature pipelines for priority banking use cases such as fraud detection, credit risk assessment, collections, customer analytics, and operational efficiency.

- Translate business requirements into feature specifications with business teams and data scientists, define success criteria, and ensure proposed features align with approved business objectives and governance requirements.

- Perform data exploration, cleaning, transformation, and statistical analysis; handle missing values and outliers; and create meaningful features such as transaction patterns and customer activity measures.

- Apply feature selection and dimensionality reduction techniques to retain useful information, remove redundant inputs, and improve model efficiency and predictive performance in collaboration with data scientists.

- Build and maintain reliable, scalable feature pipelines with Data Engineering and MLOps teams, ensuring consistent transformation rules and feature values between model training and operational use.

- Test feature quality, accuracy, completeness, and availability; prevent data leakage by excluding information that would not be available at prediction time; and retain reproducible evidence of testing.

- Prepare complete feature documentation, including business rationale, definitions, data sources, transformation rules, assumptions, limitations, and version history, to support reuse, model review, approval, and audit.

- Ensure features and pipelines are developed and maintained in line with the Bank’s AI governance framework, model risk management standards, data governance requirements, responsible AI principles, and applicable regulatory obligations.

- Assess and address feature-related risks involving data quality, bias, privacy, and stability, and escalate material issues through the appropriate governance channels in collaboration with data scientists and control owners.

- Collaborate with Data Engineering, MLOps, IT, and data scientists to support controlled deployment, integration, monitoring, and change management for feature pipelines.

- Monitor feature pipeline stability, accuracy, and changes in input data; investigate failures and inconsistencies; and support timely remediation to maintain reliable model inputs.

- Maintain a catalogue of reusable feature sets, version control, and traceability for source data and transformation code, and report the number of feature sets developed and available for reuse.

- Measure and report improvements in model performance attributable to feature engineering, together with feature pipeline stability and accuracy, using agreed evaluation methods with data scientists.

- Apply appropriate controls for data confidentiality, customer privacy, access management, and secure handling of sensitive information, and share feature engineering practices that support responsible and evidence-based use of AI.

Qualifications & Requirements
- Bachelors degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related field.

- Relevant professional certifications in data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, data engineering, or MLOps are an added advantage.

- Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or equivalent tools, including feature selection and dimensionality reduction.

- Practical knowledge of data pipelines, big-data processing, version control, reproducibility, feature monitoring, and MLOps practices.

- Good understanding of data governance, data quality, model risk management, responsible AI, information security, privacy, and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into effective feature solutions.

- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with practical experience in data exploration, data cleaning, transformation, statistical analysis, and feature engineering.

Why Join TE&OT Group
TE&OT Group has built a reputation for delivering high‑quality tourism products that celebrate Africa’s rich history and natural beauty. By joining our team you will work on projects that reach an international audience and contribute to sustainable tourism development. We value professionalism, cultural sensitivity and continuous learning, offering you a platform to sharpen your expertise while making a tangible impact on visitors’ experiences.
What You'll Do
As a Regional Representative you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end management of group tours within your assigned region.
- Plan and organise detailed tour itineraries, securing accommodations, transport and activities that align with client expectations and budget constraints.
- Lead groups on the ground, providing clear directions, timely updates and a welcoming presence throughout the journey.
- Deliver engaging commentary on historical sites, cultural landmarks and natural attractions, tailoring the narrative to the interests and knowledge level of the participants.
- Monitor the safety and well‑being of all travellers, conducting risk assessments, responding to emergencies and ensuring compliance with local regulations.
- Resolve on‑site issues such as schedule changes, accommodation challenges or guest concerns promptly and diplomatically.
- Act as the cultural ambassador for the destination, fostering respectful interactions between visitors and local communities and promoting responsible tourism practices.

What We're Looking For
To succeed in this role you will need a blend of interpersonal talent, destination expertise and logistical acumen.
- Excellent verbal communication skills, enabling you to convey information clearly and build rapport with diverse audiences.
- Deep knowledge of the region’s history, culture and attractions, supported by personal experience or formal study.
- Proven ability to coordinate complex travel logistics, including transport, accommodation, permits and local partnerships.
- Strong problem‑solving capability, allowing you to address unexpected situations calmly and efficiently.
- Demonstrated commitment to guest safety, with the capacity to conduct risk assessments and implement contingency plans.
- Flexibility to work irregular hours, including weekends and public holidays, as required by tour schedules.

If you are passionate about sharing the stories of Africa’s destinations and possess the organisational drive to create seamless travel experiences, we invite you to submit your application through this platform. Join TE&OT Group and help shape unforgettable journeys for visitors from around the world.

fields.title: RM Agribusiness Livestock Specialist at Equity Bank October 2026
fields.description:
RM Agribusiness Livestock Specialist - ()
Description

2.0 THE ROLE PURPOSE

The RM Agribusiness Livestock Specialist will be responsible for developing, managing, and growing Equity Bank Tanzania's livestock and livestock-related agribusiness portfolio. The role will provide specialized management and technical support to livestock farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, dairy groups, ranchers, pastoralist organizations, aggregators, processors, abattoirs, feed manufacturers, input suppliers, livestock traders, off-takers, and other actors across the livestock value chain. The role holder will identify and develop quality livestock financing opportunities, build a sustainable pipeline of agricultural customers, deepen existing relationships, and facilitate access to appropriate financial products including working capital, asset finance, agricultural loans, trade finance, deposits, transaction banking, and digital financial services. The RM will serve as a technical and commercial resource on livestock value chains, providing insights on livestock production systems, animal health, feed and nutrition, breeding, market dynamics, seasonality, cash flows, pricing, value addition, and associated agricultural risks.

3.0 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Livestock Agribusiness Relationship Management Develop and manage strategic relationships with livestock farmers, pastoralist groups, cooperatives, dairy groups, ranchers, aggregators, traders, processors, abattoirs, feed manufacturers, input suppliers, and Off takers. Build and maintain a strong pipeline Of quality livestock and agribusiness customers and financing opportunities. Conduct customer visits, livestock farm visits, business reviews, value chain assessments, and relationship management activities. Understand customers' livestock production models, business cycles, cash flows, financing requirements, operational challenges, and growth opportunities. Develop and implement customer acquisition, retention, and portfolio deepening strategies. Identify opportunities to cross-sell deposits, loans, insurance, payments, digital banking, and other relevant financial solutions. Act as the primary relationship contact for assigned livestock customers and coordinate resolution of customer issues with relevant internal teams. Livestock Value Chain Development • Develop strong technical and commercial knowledge Of priority livestock value chains, including dairy, beef, poultry, goats, sheep and other commercially viable livestock enterprises. Map livestock value chains to identify commercially viable financing opportunities, gaps, risks, and opportunities for value addition. Identify strategic anchor companies, processors, aggregators, cooperatives, feed companies, veterinary service providers, and Off-takers that can support structured livestock financing. Facilitate linkages between livestock producers, input suppliers, veterinary service providers, processors, markets, and financial services. Support development of livestock financing models based on production cycles, herd/flock economics, milk production, meat production, poultry cycles, and other livestock business models. Monitor livestock market trends, livestock and feed prices, disease outbreaks, weather conditions, regulations, market access, and other factors affecting the portfolio. Identify opportunities for livestock value addition, processing, aggregation, cold- chain development, and market expansion. Livestock Production & Technical Support Provide technical guidance on commercially viable livestock production Systems and business models. Support farmers and livestock enterprises to improve productivity, profitability, animal husbandry, and business management. Promote good practices in animal nutrition, feed management, breeding, housing, animal health, biosecurity, hygiene, and record keeping. Support adoption Of climate-smart livestock practices, including improved feeding systems, water management, pasture management, manure utilization, improved breeds, and resilient production Systems. Coordinate with qualified veterinary, livestock extension, and technical partners where specialized animal health or production interventions are required. Promote improved farm and livestock records to strengthen financial management and customer bankability. fields.description:
Benjamin William Mkapa Foundation employment opportunity

Job title: Regional Programme Officer

The Benjamin W. Mkapa Foundation (BMF), in collaboration with the Elizabeth Glaser Pediatric AIDS Foundation (EGPAF), is implementing an initiative funded by the U.S. Department of State focused on integrated HIV/TB, maternal and child health, and community health services. The Regional Program Officer will support the implementation, coordination, monitoring, verification, and reporting of Project-supported Health Workforce (HRH) and Community Health Services (CHS) interventions at regional, Local Government Authority (LGA), facility, and community levels. The Officer will be co-located at an EGPAF Zonal Office and serve as an integrated member of the EGPAF team for day-to-day administrative purposes while adhering to BMF programmatic guidelines and standards for technical deliverables.

The Officer will support implementation of health workforce and community health interventions in collaboration with Regional Authorities, LGAs, health facilities, communities, and other stakeholders, in line with approved plans, budgets, targets, and guidelines. Government engagement will be conducted through established EGPAF coordination mechanisms and within the agreed mandate of EGPAF and BMF. The role will primarily focus on coordination, monitoring, verification, data quality assurance, and reporting. Approximately 60% of effort will be dedicated to facility-based health workforce interventions and 40% to community health workers (CHWs).

The Officer will work under a jointly approved BMF-EGPAF workplan and participate in relevant EGPAF-led implementation and coordination activities. Day-to-day administrative supervision will be provided by EGPAF, while technical guidance and accountability for BMF programme deliverables will remain with BMF. All activities will be implemented in accordance with applicable government policies, BMF standards, and donor requirements.
Position details

- Department: Directorate of Programs and Strategic Information

- Duty station: Dodoma, Singida, Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Manyara, Tabora or Kagera (with travel to project sites as required)

- Contract period: Twelve (12) months, with the possibility of extension subject to grant renewal.

- Contract type: Full-time

- Supervises: None

Key roles and responsibilities

Key Output 1: Programme Implementation and Coordination

- Support planning, coordination, and implementation of HRH and CHS interventions in assigned regions and LGAs in line with the harmonized workplan agreed between BMF and EGPAF.

- Work closely with the EGPAF Zonal Office team and relevant BMF teams to coordinate implementation and follow-up of programme activities.

- Coordinate programme activities with Regional Authorities, LGAs, health facilities, CHW focal persons, community structures, and other stakeholders in accordance with the stakeholder engagement protocol set.

- Support regional and LGA work planning and track implementation against approved targets, budgets, milestones, and timelines.

- Participate in meetings, training, supportive supervision, technical working groups, and programme review activities.

- Identify implementation challenges, risks, and opportunities and facilitate timely corrective action and escalation.

Key Output 2: Health Workforce and Community Health Services

- Support deployment, availability, attendance, performance, retention, transition, and mainstreaming of supported skilled health workers and CHWs.

- Conduct routine physical verification and field monitoring of supported skilled health workers and CHWs.

- Support verification of payroll, allowance, and related payment inputs based on approved eligibility and verification requirements.

- Support linkages between CHWs, health facilities, and communities, including referral, follow-up, health promotion, and continuity of care.

- Provide evidence and technical input to promote government ownership, integration, transition, mainstreaming, and sustainability of supported interventions.

Key Output 3: Monitoring, Data Quality and Reporting

- Collect, verify, clean, analyse, and maintain accurate and timely HRH and CHW programme data in accordance with the data workflow defined.

- Maintain programme tracking tools, databases, implementation matrices, and other monitoring systems.

- Conduct routine data quality checks and physical verification to assess data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness.

- Track programme performance against indicators, targets, workplans, and milestones.

- Prepare timely monthly and quarterly implementation, monitoring, verification, and data quality reports for submission to EGPAF and BMF as per agreed timelines.

- Promote the use of programme evidence and data for planning, performance improvement, and decision-making.

Key Output 4: Stakeholder Engagement and Follow-up

- Maintain effective working relationships with Regional and LGA authorities, health facilities, community structures and other stakeholders through the EGPAF’s existing coordination mechanism.

- Track agreed actions, responsible persons, timelines, and status of implementation.

- Follow up identified gaps and corrective actions and document evidence of resolution.

- Escalate significant implementation, compliance, workforce, financial verification, or data quality issues to the BMF Program Manager, with the EGPAF Zonal Lead informed as appropriate.

Key Output 5: Learning and Continuous Improvement

- Document lessons learned, good practices, innovations, implementation challenges, and programme results.

- Contribute to programme reviews and learning activities.

- Provide practical recommendations to strengthen programme implementation and performance.

Required qualifications and experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Health Services Management, Nursing, Medicine, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Monitoring and Evaluation, or another relevant field.

- At least five (5) years’ experience in health workforce, community health, programme implementation, monitoring, or health systems strengthening is desirable.

- Experience working with Regional Secretariats, LGAs, health facilities, or community structures is an advantage.

- Good understanding of programme monitoring, data collection, verification, reporting, and data quality.

- Ability to analyse programme data and translate findings into practical actions.

- Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office and relevant data management systems.

- Strong communication, coordination, interpersonal, and report-writing skills.

- Ability and willingness to undertake frequent field travel.

Key competencies and skills

- Health workforce and community health systems expertise

- Programme implementation, coordination, and planning

- Monitoring, data quality assurance, reporting, and data use

- Analytical thinking and problem-solving

- Stakeholder engagement, collaboration, and communication

- Accountability, integrity, adaptability, and attention to detail

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against:

- Timeliness and quality of programme implementation, coordination, and reporting against approved workplans, targets, and milestones.

- Completion and quality of monitoring, verification, and field support activities for supported health workers and community health workers.

- Accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness of programme data, including quality of supporting documentation and verification records.

- Timely identification, escalation, and resolution of implementation, workforce, compliance, and data quality risks and gaps.

- Effectiveness of stakeholder engagement, coordination, and follow-up with Regional Authorities, LGAs, health facilities, communities, and implementing partners.

- Contribution to improved deployment, availability, performance, retention, transition, mainstreaming, and sustainability of supported health workforce and community health interventions.

Kindly attach the required documents as stated in the application form. The deadline for the application is 09th October 2026.

BMF is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. MSF offers assistance to people based on need, irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF is therefore guided by the principles of neutrality and impartiality. These principles must apply to all MSF staff. Accountabilities Clean bedrooms, bathrooms, toilets and other rooms in MSF houses. Do the laundry iron clothes and other housekeeping activities. Support the cook (washing up, cleaning the kitchen, etc.). Sweep and mop the floors. Restock supplies (toilet paper, soap, etc.) as required. Upon arrival, prepare hot water for tea/coffee and refill drinking water. Check that the toilets are well stocked with paper, soap and condoms. Check that the water supply (kitchen, showers, etc.) is sufficient during water cuts. Keep premises properly locked (doors, windows). Minimum educational qualification None is required Experience None is required Languages Good English spoken and written desirable, and Kiswahili are essential. Competencies Commitment Flexibility Stress Management Results Teamwork Service Women, or any person feeling like being part of a minority is encouraged to apply. Application details All interested candidates shall submit their motivation letter, CV, copy of your national ID, and copy of relevant professional certificates (mandatory to submit diploma and valid MCT registration or license) no later than Thursday, 15th October 2026 at 17:00 (5 PM).Advertisement Please quote the job title on the email subject “CLEANER”. Please send your application to the email address [email protected]. The applications can also be submitted at MSF offices situated at House No. 8, Majaliwa Road, Mlimwa C, Dodoma City Council. ONLY SHORT-LISTED CANDIDATES WILL BE CONTACTED If you receive no contact within 6 weeks, you can consider that you have not been pre-selected.Advertisement Personal data protection The protection of your personal data is important to MSF. By submitting your application, you consent to MSF using your data only for the recruitment process to have all the information and documents necessary to proceed with the recruitment, validation of your application and selection of the most suitable candidate. Your data will be treated confidentially. Only people part of the recruitment process have access to your data. MSF does not sell your data under any circumstances. If you have any questions or requests, you can contact [email protected]. Inclusion and diversity At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas, and experiences work together for the social mission of MSF to create better outcomes for the patients and the communities we work with. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.Advertisement MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo reference checks. Please note that applying to MSF is free of charge, MSF does not charge applicants to consider their application.

fields.title: Senior Medical Doctor at Shanta Mining October 2026
fields.description:
Position: Senior Medical Doctor
Company: Shanta Mining Company Limited (New Luika Gold Mine)

Department: Health and Community

Location: Tanzania (Remote Mine Site)

Reports To: Occupational Health Manager

Roster: 6 Weeks ON, 3 Weeks OFF

Job ID: 146474

Position Purpose
The Senior Medical Doctor provides overall clinical leadership and oversees full-scope medical services at New Luika Gold Mine, encompassing primary care, emergency medicine, trauma management, occupational health surveillance, and public health initiatives. Reporting to the Occupational Health Manager, this role manages the on-site clinic operations, medical personnel, emergency evacuations, and statutory compliance in accordance with Tanzanian regulations and Shanta Gold corporate standards.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Clinical Leadership & Medical Care:

Provide expert clinical diagnosis, treatment, and medical case management for all employee health conditions, occupational injuries, and trauma emergencies.

Lead emergency medical response protocols, critical care stabilization, aeromedical evacuations, and referral coordination with external hospitals.

Clinic Operations & Team Management:

Direct daily operations of the on-site medical facility in compliance with Tanzanian laws, Medical Council of Tanganyika (MCT) regulations, and OSHA guidelines.

Manage clinic staff schedules, performance reviews, training programs, leave rotations, and multidisciplinary team development.

Oversee procurement, inventory controls, pharmaceutical registers, and budget allocation for medical consumables and equipment.

Occupational & Public Health Programs:

Formulate and supervise occupational health surveillance programs, pre-employment screening, periodic checks, and return-to-work fitness evaluations in partnership with HR.

Design and execute public health strategies targeting malaria, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, non-communicable diseases (NCDs), and community health dispensary support projects.

Maintain comprehensive medical records, confidential health registries, and statutory compliance reporting.

Qualifications & Requirements
Education & Professional Registration:

Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB / MBBS) or equivalent medical degree.

Master’s Degree in Public Health, Occupational Medicine, or Emergency Medicine is desirable.

Full registration and a valid, active practicing license from the Medical Council of Tanganyika (MCT).

Valid certifications in Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS), and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS).

Experience & Technical Skills:

Minimum of seven (7) years post-internship clinical experience.

At least three (3) years of supervisory/clinical management experience in an industrial, mining, remote site, or occupational health environment.

Expert knowledge of Tanzanian health legislation, OSHA statutory guidelines, and emergency medical management.

Excellent leadership, clinical decision-making, and communication skills suitable for a 6×3 remote rotational deployment.

How to Apply
Interested and qualified medical professionals are requested to submit their application package as follows:

Required Documents:

Application Letter

Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV)

Copies of relevant academic degrees, professional certificates, and active MCT practicing license

Email Destination: Send your complete application to
recruitment@shantagoldltd.com

Email Subject Line: Explicitly state “Senior Medical Doctor” in the email subject line.

Application Deadline: 08 October 2026

Recruitment Fraud Warning & Equal Opportunity:

Shanta Mining Company Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not charge any application, processing, or recruitment fees at any stage. Applicants who do not hear from the company within fourteen (14) days following the closing date should consider their application unsuccessful.

Position Purpose
The Occupational Health Nurse delivers high-quality clinical nursing care, supports occupational health surveillance, and assists with employee health programs at New Luika Gold Mine.
